```sql
WITH all_events AS (
    -- Stack the branches
    SELECT 'site' AS src, id AS entity_id, commissioned_on
    FROM sites
    WHERE tariff IN ('FLAT', 'EV')
      AND zone = 'Z4'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'site_2' AS src, id, commissioned_on
    FROM sites
    WHERE commissioned_on < DATE '2025-05-07'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'site_3' AS src, id, commissioned_on
    FROM sites
)
SELECT src, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(entity_id) AS total_entity_id, MAX(commissioned_on) AS latest_commissioned_on
FROM all_events
GROUP BY src
ORDER BY src
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

site_side = (
    df_sites
    .filter((F.col("tariff").isin("FLAT", "EV")) & (F.col("zone") == "Z4"))
    .select(
        F.lit("site").alias("src"),
        F.col("id").alias("entity_id"),
        "commissioned_on",
    )
)

site_rows = (
    df_sites
    .filter(F.col("commissioned_on") < F.lit("2025-05-07").cast("date"))
    .select(F.lit("site_2").alias("src"), "id", "commissioned_on")
)

site_side_2 = df_sites.select(F.lit("site_3").alias("src"), "id", "commissioned_on")

all_events = (
    site_side
    .union(site_rows)
    .union(site_side_2)
)

result = (
    all_events
    .groupBy("src")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.sum("entity_id").alias("total_entity_id"),
        F.max("commissioned_on").alias("latest_commissioned_on"),
    )
    .orderBy("src")
)
```

```sql
    FROM orders o
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sessions s

          AND DATEDIFF(s.started_at, o.order_date) >= 90
```

```python
        df_sessions.filter(F.col("device") != "desktop").alias("s"),

        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(F.col("o.id"), F.col("o.channel"), F.col("o.status"))

result = (
    qualified
    .groupBy("channel", "status")
```

```sql
WITH metrics AS (SELECT id, dorie_span, order_date, status, channel, onyx_thicket, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount, id) AS event_seq, CORR(onyx_thicket, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount, CORR(onyx_thicket, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(order_date), channel) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount_2 FROM polar_plateaus WHERE dorie_span IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.id, s.dorie_span, s.order_date, s.onyx_thicket, s.event_seq, s.corr_shipping_fee_amount_2, (SELECT AVG(o2.discount) FROM polar_plateaus o2 WHERE o2.dorie_span = s.dorie_span) AS avg_order_discount FROM metrics s
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

discount_by_store_id = df_polar_plateaus.groupBy("dorie_span").agg(F.avg("discount").alias("avg_order_discount"))

metrics = (
    df_polar_plateaus
    .filter(F.col("dorie_span").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "dorie_span",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "onyx_thicket",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.corr("onyx_thicket", "amount").over(Window.partitionBy("channel")).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount"),
        F.corr("onyx_thicket", "amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "channel")).alias("corr_shipping_fee_amount_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .join(discount_by_store_id, on="dorie_span", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "dorie_span",
        "order_date",
        "onyx_thicket",
        "event_seq",
        "corr_shipping_fee_amount_2",
        F.col("avg_order_discount"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Scope the enrollments rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at,
        enrolled_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS enrolled_at_plus_30m,
        CONCAT_WS('|', grade_status, term) AS grade_status_term_label
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE term IS NOT NULL
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN score >= 58.8 THEN 'A' WHEN score >= 35.8 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS score_tier,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(grade_status_term_label), 1, 4) AS grade_status_term_label_prefix,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at_plus_30m) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m
    FROM valid
    WHERE term NOT IN ('2025T1', '2024T2')
)
SELECT id, field, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT id, hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m, score
    FROM labeled
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR field IN (hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m, score)
) unp
ORDER BY id, field
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("term").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
        (F.col("enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("enrolled_at_plus_30m"),
        F.concat_ws("|", F.col("grade_status"), F.col("term")).alias("grade_status_term_label"),
    )
)

labeled = (
    valid
    .filter(~F.col("term").isin("2025T1", "2024T2"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("score") >= 58.8, "A").when(F.col("score") >= 35.8, "B").otherwise("C").alias("score_tier"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("grade_status_term_label")), 1, 4).alias("grade_status_term_label_prefix"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("enrolled_at_plus_30m")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("enrolled_at"))) / 3600, 1).alias("hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m"),
    )
)

result = (
    labeled
    .select("id", "hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m", "score")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["hours_enrolled_at_to_enrolled_at_plus_30m", "score"],
        variableColumnName="field",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .orderBy("id", "field")
)
```

```sql
WITH prepared AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        listing_ref,
        property_kind,
        asking_price,
        offer_amt,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', offer_made_at) AS offer_made_at_hour
    FROM rent_ledgers
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous offer_made_at_hour per listing_ref
    SELECT *, LAG(offer_made_at_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_ref ORDER BY offer_made_at_hour, id) AS prev_offer_made_at_hour
    FROM prepared
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_offer_made_at_hour IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(offer_made_at_hour) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_offer_made_at_hour)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_ref ORDER BY offer_made_at_hour, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    id,
    offer_amt,
    offer_made_at_hour,
    prev_offer_made_at_hour,
    INITCAP(TRIM(property_kind)) AS property_kind_clean
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY prev_offer_made_at_hour NULLS LAST, offer_made_at_hour, id
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_rent_ledgers
    .select(
        "id",
        "listing_ref",
        "property_kind",
        "asking_price",
        "offer_amt",
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("offer_made_at")).alias("offer_made_at_hour"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_offer_made_at_hour", F.lag("offer_made_at_hour").over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref").orderBy("offer_made_at_hour", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_offer_made_at_hour").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("offer_made_at_hour") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_offer_made_at_hour")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref").orderBy("offer_made_at_hour", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "offer_amt",
        "offer_made_at_hour",
        "prev_offer_made_at_hour",
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("property_kind"))).alias("property_kind_clean"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("prev_offer_made_at_hour").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("offer_made_at_hour").asc(),
        "id",
    )
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped_minibar_charges AS (
    -- Scope the minibar_charges rows
    SELECT
        id,
        guest_stay_id,
        board_basis,
        star_rating,
        late_checkout,
        LENGTH(TRIM(board_basis)) AS board_basis_len,
        COALESCE(nights, 0) AS nights_filled
    FROM minibar_charges
),
exploded_detail_minibar_charges AS (
    -- One row per minibar_charge
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.guest_stay_id,
        s.board_basis,
        s.star_rating,
        s.late_checkout,
        s.board_basis_len,
        m.id AS minibar_charge_id,
        m.late_checkout AS minibar_charge_late_checkout,
        m.nights AS minibar_charge_nights,
        m.board_basis AS minibar_charge_board_basis,
        m.star_rating AS minibar_charge_star_rating
    FROM scoped_minibar_charges s
    JOIN minibar_charges m ON m.guest_stay_id = s.guest_stay_id
),
line_level_minibar_charges AS (
    -- One row per minibar_charge
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.guest_stay_id,
        s.board_basis,
        s.star_rating,
        s.late_checkout,
        s.board_basis_len,
        s.minibar_charge_id,
        s.minibar_charge_nights,
        m.id AS minibar_charge_id_2,
        m.board_basis AS minibar_charge_board_basis_2,
        m.checkin_day AS minibar_charge_checkin_day,
        m.late_checkout AS minibar_charge_late_checkout_2
    FROM exploded_detail_minibar_charges s
    JOIN minibar_charges m ON m.guest_stay_id = s.guest_stay_id AND m.checkin_day >= DATE '2024-12-14'
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(minibar_charge_checkin_day) OVER w_minibar_charge_id_2_by_board AS prev_minibar_charge_checkin_day,
        ROUND(star_rating / NULLIF(SUM(star_rating) OVER w_minibar_charge_id_minibar_ch, 0), 4) AS star_rating_share_of_minibar_charge_id_minibar_c
    FROM line_level_minibar_charges
    WINDOW w_minibar_charge_id_2_by_board AS (PARTITION BY minibar_charge_id_2 ORDER BY board_basis_len, id, minibar_charge_id, minibar_charge_id_2), w_minibar_charge_id_minibar_ch AS (PARTITION BY minibar_charge_id, minibar_charge_id_2)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    guest_stay_id,
    board_basis,
    star_rating,
    late_checkout,
    board_basis_len,
    minibar_charge_id,
    minibar_charge_nights,
```

```sql
vs_group AS (

        g.max_play_ms_played,

    FROM with_children_plays s
```

```sql
    -- Price each reading with the tariff window it falls into
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,
        r.kwh,
        r.voltage,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM stg_berths r
    JOIN dim_pantries st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN delta_cruisers tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
zone_stats AS (
    -- Median kwh per zone
    SELECT zone, PERCENTILE_APPROX(kwh, 0.5) AS median_kwh
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY zone
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.median_kwh, ROUND(s.kwh - g.median_kwh, 2) AS kwh_minus_median
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN zone_stats g ON g.zone = s.zone
    WHERE s.kwh >= g.median_kwh
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(read_at) AS read_at_day,
        site_id,
        zone,
        ROUND(SUM(kwh_minus_median) / NULLIF(SUM(kwh), 0), 3) AS kwh_minus_median_to_kwh_ratio,
        MAX(kwh) AS max_kwh,
        ROUND(SUM(voltage) / NULLIF(SUM(kwh), 0), 3) AS voltage_to_kwh_ratio,
        MAX(read_at) AS midnight_gable,
        MIN(kwh) AS min_kwh,
        SUM(voltage) FILTER (WHERE zone IN ('Z4', 'Z2')) AS voltage_zone_in_z4_z2
    FROM outliers
    WHERE kwh_minus_median <= 96.0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING MAX(kwh_minus_median) > -60.0
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach stg_berths metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.voltage), 2) FROM stg_berths m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS avg_reading_voltage,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM stg_berths m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at
    FROM rollup_base s
)
SELECT
    read_at_day,
    site_id,
    kwh_minus_median_to_kwh_ratio,
    max_kwh,
    voltage_to_kwh_ratio,
    midnight_gable,
    min_kwh,
    avg_reading_voltage,
    last_reading_read_at,
    LENGTH(TRIM(zone)) AS zone_len,
    GREATEST(max_kwh, voltage_to_kwh_ratio) AS greatest_max_kwh_voltage_to_kwh_ratio
FROM with_counts
ORDER BY site_id
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_stg_berths.alias("r")
    .join(df_dim_pantries.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(

        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))

        "inner",

    )
)

zone_stats = (
    in_window
    .groupBy("zone")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("kwh", 0.5).alias("median_kwh"))
)

outliers = (
    in_window.alias("s")

)

result = (

        "site_id",
        "kwh_minus_median_to_kwh_ratio",
        "max_kwh",
        "voltage_to_kwh_ratio",
        "midnight_gable",
        "min_kwh",
        "avg_reading_voltage",
        "last_reading_read_at",
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

        listener_id,

        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

enriched_listener AS (
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
    FROM qualified
),
metrics AS (

        COUNT(*) OVER w_row_count AS rows_in_row_count,

    FROM tagged

    SUM(CASE WHEN tap_media NOT IN ('cash', 'qr') THEN distinct_tap_media_in_row_count ELSE 0 END) AS distinct_tap_media_in_row_count_tap_media_not_in
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_teal_typewriters
    .filter(F.col("pacific_gazebo") > 49)
    .select(
        "id",
        "console_amt",
        "tap_media",
        "pacific_gazebo",
        "headway_minutes",
        "route_opened_date",
        "kiosk_owner",
        F.quarter(F.col("route_opened_date")).alias("route_opened_date_quarter"),
    )
)

stats = (
    recent
    .groupBy(
        F.year("route_opened_date").alias("route_opened_date_year"),
        "tap_media",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("headway_minutes").alias("max_headway_minutes"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("tap_media")).alias("tap_media_list"),
        F.min("headway_minutes").alias("min_headway_minutes"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.avg("pacific_gazebo").alias("avg_dwell_secs_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_dwell_secs_check") > 72)
    .drop("avg_dwell_secs_check")

    .crossJoin(stats.agg(F.avg("min_headway_minutes").alias("overall_avg_min_headway_minutes")))

        F.size(F.collect_set("tap_media").over(Window.partitionBy("row_count"))).alias("distinct_tap_media_in_row_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .rollup("seq_no", "tap_media")
```

```python
    df_dim_gazebos

        "crew_size",
        "progress_percent",
        "floor_count",
        "incident_ts",
        "has_crane",
    )
)
```

```sql
        term_code,

        FLOOR(lesson_mins / 25) * 25 AS lesson_mins_bucket,
        CASE WHEN term_code IN ('T1', 'T3') THEN 'group_a' WHEN term_code = 'T2' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS term_code_group,
        CASE WHEN term_code IN ('T3', 'T1') THEN 'group_a' WHEN term_code = 'T2' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS term_code_group_2
    FROM decoder_dashboards
    WHERE grade_level > 2
),
with_parent_pupil AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.tugboat_rank AS pupil_enrolled_on,
        c.hired_date AS campus_hired_date,
        c.chronicle_flag AS campus_absent_days
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN airships p ON p.id = s.pupil_id
    JOIN armatures c ON c.id = p.campus_id
),
term_code_group_stats AS (
    -- Avg lesson_mins per term_code_group
    SELECT term_code_group, AVG(lesson_mins) AS avg_lesson_mins
    FROM with_parent_pupil
    GROUP BY term_code_group
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_lesson_mins,
        ROUND(s.lesson_mins - g.avg_lesson_mins, 2) AS lesson_mins_minus_avg
    FROM with_parent_pupil s
    JOIN term_code_group_stats g ON g.term_code_group = s.term_code_group
    WHERE s.lesson_mins > g.avg_lesson_mins
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(lesson_mins_minus_avg, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pupil_enrolled_on), term_code_group ORDER BY lesson_mins NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_lesson_mins_minus_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_lesson_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY term_code_group ORDER BY lesson_mins_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS avg_lesson_mins_avg_2_prior,
        LAST_VALUE(lesson_mins_minus_avg) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pupil_enrolled_on), term_code_group ORDER BY lesson_mins NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_lesson_mins_minus_avg
    FROM above_average
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    term_code_group_2,
    pupil_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE term_code IN ('T1', 'T2')) AS n_term_code_in_t1_t2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN term_code NOT IN ('T1', 'T3') THEN second_lesson_mins_minus_avg ELSE 0 END) AS second_lesson_mins_minus_avg_term_code_not_in_t1,
    MAX(lesson_mins) AS onyx_florist
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY ROLLUP(term_code_group_2, pupil_id)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_decoder_dashboards
    .filter(F.col("grade_level") > 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "pupil_id",
        "term_code",
        "campus_kind",
        "lesson_mins",
        (F.floor(F.col("lesson_mins") / 25) * 25).alias("lesson_mins_bucket"),
        F.when(F.col("term_code").isin("T1", "T3"), "group_a").when(F.col("term_code") == "T2", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("term_code_group"),
        F.when(F.col("term_code").isin("T3", "T1"), "group_a").when(F.col("term_code") == "T2", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("term_code_group_2"),
    )
)

with_parent_pupil = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(df_airships.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.pupil_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_armatures.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("p.campus_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("p.tugboat_rank").alias("pupil_enrolled_on"),
        F.col("c.hired_date").alias("campus_hired_date"),
        F.col("c.chronicle_flag").alias("campus_absent_days"),
    )
)

term_code_group_stats = (
    with_parent_pupil
    .groupBy("term_code_group")
    .agg(F.avg("lesson_mins").alias("avg_lesson_mins"))
)

above_average = (
    with_parent_pupil.alias("s")
    .join(term_code_group_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.term_code_group") == F.col("s.term_code_group"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.lesson_mins") > F.col("g.avg_lesson_mins"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_lesson_mins",
        F.round(F.col("s.lesson_mins") - F.col("g.avg_lesson_mins"), 2).alias("lesson_mins_minus_avg"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    above_average
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("lesson_mins_minus_avg", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "pupil_enrolled_on"), "term_code_group").orderBy(F.col("lesson_mins").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_lesson_mins_minus_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("avg_lesson_mins").over(Window.partitionBy("term_code_group").orderBy("lesson_mins_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)), 2).alias("avg_lesson_mins_avg_2_prior"),
        F.last("lesson_mins_minus_avg", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "pupil_enrolled_on"), "term_code_group").orderBy(F.col("lesson_mins").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_lesson_mins_minus_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .rollup("term_code_group_2", "pupil_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("term_code").isin("T1", "T2"), 1)).alias("n_term_code_in_t1_t2"),
        F.sum(F.when(~F.col("term_code").isin("T1", "T3"), F.col("second_lesson_mins_minus_avg")).otherwise(0)).alias("second_lesson_mins_minus_avg_term_code_not_in_t1"),
        F.max("lesson_mins").alias("onyx_florist"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_jade_lockers
    .select(

        "host",

        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") < "2024-01-01") & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "value",
        F.substring("host", 1, 3).alias("indigo_rampart"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("status_code") > 283)
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts"), "attr_key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key")).alias("derrick_span"),
        F.avg("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "level").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("status_code_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "level").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "attr_key")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "attr_key"))), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped_app_logs = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("derrick_span").asc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

grouped = (
    deduped_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code_avg_6_prior") >= 422, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_code_avg_6_prior_tier"),
        "attr_key",
```

```sql
        a.club_id AS athlete_club_id,
        c.fixture_result AS club_fixture_result,
```

```sql
        MIN(budget) OVER w_recent AS running_min_budget,
        COUNT(budget) OVER w_recent AS running_count_budget
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)

    measure,
    value

        running_avg_budget
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    .select(

        F.concat("dept_name", F.lit(" - "), "location").alias("dept_name_location"),
        F.upper("dept_name").alias("dept_name_upper"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("NONE")).alias("dept_name_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (

    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("budget", "id")))

base = (

        "budget",
        "dept_name_upper",
        "dept_name_clean",

        "budget",
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS est_count,
    COALESCE(b.est_avg_kwh, 0) AS est_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```python
ok_monthly = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "OK")

    .agg(F.count("*").alias("ok_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("ok_total_kwh"))

    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at").alias("read_at_month"))

    )
)

    .select(
```

```sql
    FROM metrics

screened AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
```

```python
        "revenue_share",
        "restocked_date",
        "out_of_stock",
    )
)

qualified = (
    prepared_store_visits.alias("s")
    .join(df_restock_orders.alias("r"), (F.col("r.outlet_no") == F.col("s.outlet_id")) & (F.col("r.shrink_units") > 4), "left_anti")
)

metrics = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "id",
        "outlet_id",
        "promo_mech",
        "restocked_date",
        "out_of_stock",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", F.date_trunc("month", "restocked_date")).orderBy("restocked_date")), 3).alias("restocked_date_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("promo_mech").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", "outlet_id"))).alias("distinct_promo_mech_in_visit_purpose_outlet_id"),
        F.sum("revenue_share").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", F.date_trunc("month", "restocked_date")).orderBy("restocked_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_revenue_share"),
        F.max("revenue_share").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", "outlet_id")).alias("visit_purpose_outlet_id_max_revenue_share"),
        F.last("revenue_share").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", F.date_trunc("month", "restocked_date")).orderBy("restocked_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_revenue_share"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", "outlet_id")).alias("rows_in_visit_purpose_outlet_id"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("running_revenue_share").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech")).alias("promo_mech_max_running_revenue_share"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech")).alias("rows_in_promo_mech"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech").orderBy(F.col("last_revenue_share").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("last_revenue_share_percent_rank"),

        F.max("promo_start_day").alias("last_promo_run_promo_start_day_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("promo_run_count"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    screened.alias("s")
    .join(promo_run_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.outlet_id") == F.col("s.outlet_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "p.last_promo_run_promo_start_day",
        "p.last_promo_run_promo_start_day_2",

    .select("s.*", F.col("o.rep_label").alias("outlet_rep_label"))
)

    .groupBy(

        "distinct_promo_mech_in_visit_purpose_outlet_id",
        F.date_trunc("month", "last_promo_run_promo_start_day").alias("last_promo_run_promo_start_day_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("last_revenue_share_percent_rank"), 2).alias("total_last_revenue_share_percent_rank"),
        F.min("promo_run_count").alias("min_promo_run_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)

        "distinct_promo_mech_in_visit_purpose_outlet_id",
        "last_promo_run_promo_start_day_month",
        "total_last_revenue_share_percent_rank",
        "min_promo_run_count",
        "row_count",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("last_promo_run_promo_start_day_2_ym").desc(),
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter eateries
    SELECT *
    FROM eateries
    WHERE prep_minutes >= 25
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous served_at per course_kind
    SELECT *, LAG(served_at) OVER (PARTITION BY course_kind ORDER BY served_at, id) AS prev_served_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_served_at IS NULL OR served_at > prev_served_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY course_kind ORDER BY served_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        course_kind,
        session_id,
        MIN(served_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(served_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(served_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(served_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_kind, session_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY n_events, session_id) AS rows_in_n_events_session_id,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_n_events_by_session_start, 3) AS session_start_cume_dist,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(course_kind) OVER (PARTITION BY n_events, session_id)) AS distinct_course_kind_in_n_events_session_id,
        RANK() OVER w_n_events_by_session_start_ti AS session_start_rank
    FROM session_summary
    WINDOW w_n_events_by_session_start AS (PARTITION BY n_events ORDER BY session_start DESC, course_kind, session_id), w_n_events_session_id AS (PARTITION BY n_events, session_id), w_n_events_by_session_start_ti AS (PARTITION BY n_events ORDER BY session_start DESC)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE kwh > 20.4

        si.site_name,

    FROM filtered_readings s

        read_at,
        voltage,
        quality,

        site_name,
        site_tariff
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage, id) AS rn
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
reading_stats AS (
    -- Per-site meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        site_id,
        COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
        MIN(read_at) AS first_reading_read_at,
        MAX(read_at) AS last_reading_read_at
    FROM meter_readings
    GROUP BY site_id
),
profiled AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(m.reading_count, 0) AS reading_count,
        m.first_reading_read_at,

    FROM unique_rows s
    LEFT JOIN reading_stats m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose site matches
    SELECT s.*
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("event_type") == "resolved")
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",

        F.month(F.col("event_at")).alias("event_at_month"),
    )
)

sequenced = (

    .select(

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at_month", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.max("event_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("actor", "ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("event_at_month_max_6_prior"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("ticket_id").over(Window.partitionBy("actor"))).alias("distinct_ticket_id_in_actor"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("event_at_month", "ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at_date").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("event_at_date_cume_dist"),
        F.first("event_at_date").over(Window.partitionBy("event_at_month", F.year("event_at_date")).orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_event_at_date"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor")).alias("rows_in_ticket_id_actor"),
        F.max("event_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("event_at_month", "ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_event_at_month_so_far"),
        F.sum("event_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("actor", "ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_event_at_month"),
    )
)

w_seq_no_event_type = Window.partitionBy("seq_no", "event_type")
with_trends = (
    sequenced
    .withColumn("rows_in_seq_no_event_type", F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_seq_no_event_type))
    .withColumn("running_max_event_at_month_so_far", F.sum("max_event_at_month_so_far").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "first_event_at_date")).orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)
```

```sql
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        YEAR(enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_year
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL

enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(enrolled_at_year / NULLIF(score, 0), 3) AS enrolled_at_year_per_score,
        COALESCE(term, 'UNKNOWN') AS term_or_unknown
    FROM base_enrollments
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, LENGTH(TRIM(term_or_unknown)) AS term_or_unknown_len
    FROM enriched
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_student_id_enrolled_at_year AS term_or_unknown_len_dense_rank,

),
rollup_base AS (

        MAX(enrolled_at) AS last_enrolled_at,
        ROUND(SUM(enrolled_at_year) / NULLIF(SUM(term_or_unknown_len_dense_rank), 0), 3) AS enrolled_at_year_to_term_or_unknown_len_dense_ra,

        SUM(term_or_unknown_len_percent_rank) FILTER (WHERE grade_status = 'INCOMPLETE') AS term_or_unknown_len_percent_rank_grade_status_in
```

```sql
        ROUND(days_since_played_at / NULLIF(SUM(days_since_played_at) OVER w_device, 0), 4) AS days_since_played_at_share_of_device,
        NTH_VALUE(played_at, 2) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_played_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_played_at,
        NTH_VALUE(days_since_played_at, 2) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_days_since_played_at,
```

```sql
    FROM transactions

    FROM with_prev

islands AS (

    FROM flagged
)

    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debit_count,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS num_merchants,
    MIN(txn_time) AS first_txn_time,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS txn_type_list,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS num_txn_types,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_quartiles
FROM islands

HAVING debit_count < 1000
ORDER BY num_merchants DESC
```

```python
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("start_date_dense_rank"),

        F.lead("start_date", 3).over(w_all_by_start_date).alias("next3_start_date"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("product", "holder_id").orderBy("premium")), 3).alias("premium_cume_dist"),

)

leaders = (

    .filter(F.col("start_date_dense_rank") == 1)

summary = (

    .groupBy(

)
```

```sql
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    SUM(session_no) AS total_session_no,
    ROUND(SUM(n_events) / NULLIF(SUM(session_csat), 0), 3) AS n_events_to_session_csat_ratio
```

```python
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
    )
```

```sql
        FIRST_VALUE(session_no) OVER (ORDER BY session_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_session_no

),
source_stats AS (
    -- Avg session_no_avg_3_prior per source
    SELECT source, AVG(session_no_avg_3_prior) AS avg_session_no_avg_3_prior
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY source
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_session_no_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(s.session_no_avg_3_prior - g.avg_session_no_avg_3_prior, 2) AS session_no_avg_3_prior_minus_avg
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN source_stats g ON g.source = s.source
    WHERE s.session_no_avg_3_prior > g.avg_session_no_avg_3_prior

-- Final projection
```

```python
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_plays.withColumn("prev_played_at", F.lag("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id").orderBy("played_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_played_at").isNull() | (F.col("played_at") > F.col("prev_played_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

metrics = (
```

```python
        "unit_price",
        F.round(F.col("unit_price") / F.nullif(F.col("qty"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("unit_price_per_qty"),
    )
)

detail_rows = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_stock_moves.alias("st"), F.col("st.warehouse_id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
```

```sql
    FROM support_agents
    WHERE hired_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-09' AND DATE '2025-11-09'
),

    -- Per-agent tickets metrics
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
        MAX(csat) AS max_ticket_csat,
        MIN(closed_at) AS first_ticket_closed_at
    FROM tickets
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(t.ticket_count, 0) AS ticket_count,
        t.max_ticket_csat,
        t.first_ticket_closed_at
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN ticket_stats t ON t.agent_id = s.id
),
detail_rows_tickets AS (
    -- One row per ticket
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_name,
        s.team,
        s.tier_group,
        s.tier_group_2,
        s.max_ticket_csat,
        s.first_ticket_closed_at,

    last_known_max_ticket_csat,
    least_cnt_distinct_tier_groups_seq,
    last_max_ticket_csat,
```

```python
    .select(

        "tier",
        F.when(F.col("tier").isin("T1", "T3"), "group_a").when(F.col("tier") == "T2", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("tier_group"),
        F.when(F.col("tier").isin("T2", "T3"), "group_a").when(F.col("tier") == "T1", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("tier_group_2"),
    )
)

    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(

        "t.max_ticket_csat",
        "t.first_ticket_closed_at",
    )
)

detail_rows_tickets = (
    profiled.alias("s")
    .join(df_tickets.alias("t"), (F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("t.requester_id").between(2, 22)), "left")
    .select(

        "s.team",

)

rollup_base = (

    .filter(F.col("max_ticket_csat") > 3)
    .groupBy("max_ticket_csat")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("tier_group").alias("distinct_tier_groups"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

derived = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "max_ticket_csat",
        "distinct_tier_groups",

    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("max_ticket_csat") >= 3)
    .select(
        "max_ticket_csat",
        "least_cnt_distinct_tier_groups_quintile",
        "max_ticket_csat_max_6_prior",
        "last_known_max_ticket_csat",
        "least_cnt_distinct_tier_groups_seq",

        F.round(F.col("second_max_ticket_csat") / F.nullif(F.col("distinct_tier_groups"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("second_max_ticket_csat_per_distinct_tier_groups"),
```

```sql
WITH scoped_claims AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        reported_at,

metrics AS (

        FIRST_VALUE(approved_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY approved_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_approved_amount,
        NTH_VALUE(reported_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY approved_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_reported_at,
        MAX(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY approved_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS approved_amount_max_4,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id ORDER BY approved_amount, id) AS approved_amount_decile
    FROM scoped_claims
    WINDOW w_claim_type_or_unknown_adjust AS (PARTITION BY claim_type_or_unknown, adjuster_id)
),
joined_policy AS (

        a.level AS adjuster_level
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.policy_id
    JOIN adjusters a ON a.id = s.adjuster_id
),
derived AS (

        ADD_MONTHS(policy_end_date, 1) AS policy_end_date_plus_1m,

    FROM joined_policy
),
```

```sql
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS k, v
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, MAX(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_max_latency_ms
    FROM exploded
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(latency_ms, status_code) OVER w_running AS corr_latency_ms_status_code,
        CORR(status_code, latency_ms) OVER w_running AS corr_status_code_latency_ms
    FROM enriched
    WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY k)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(k, 1, 2) AS k_prefix
    FROM scored
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        k_max_latency_ms,
        k_prefix,
        SUM(corr_status_code_latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms
    FROM cleaned
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    k,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.5) AS latency_ms_p50,
    ROUND(SUM(latency_ms) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN k = 'trace' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS latency_ms_per_trace,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(status_code, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS status_code_quartiles,
    ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 2) AS avg_latency_ms,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms_quartiles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'region' THEN status_code ELSE 0 END) AS region_status_code
FROM metrics
GROUP BY k
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

enriched = exploded.select("*", F.max("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("k")).alias("k_max_latency_ms"))

scored = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("corr_latency_ms_status_code", F.corr("latency_ms", "status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("k")))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("k")))
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.substring("k", 1, 2).alias("k_prefix"))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "k_max_latency_ms",
        "k_prefix",
        F.sum("corr_status_code_latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("k")).alias("k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("k")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("latency_ms", 0.5).alias("latency_ms_p50"),
        F.round(F.sum("latency_ms") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "trace", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("latency_ms_per_trace"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_code_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("latency_ms"), 2).alias("avg_latency_ms"),
        F.percentile_approx("k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("k_sum_corr_status_code_latency_ms_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", F.col("status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("region_status_code"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        qty,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        qty - unit_price AS qty_minus_unit_price,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(operator), 1, 3) AS operator_prefix
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE TO_DATE(moved_at) < DATE '2025-03-02'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(move_type) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id)) AS distinct_move_type_in_warehouse_id,
        MAX(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id_max_unit_price
    FROM base
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', move_type, operator_prefix) AS move_type_operator_prefix_label
    FROM ranked
),
move_type_stats AS (
    -- Avg unit_price per move_type
    SELECT move_type, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY move_type
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_unit_price,
        ROUND(s.unit_price - g.avg_unit_price, 2) AS unit_price_minus_avg
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN move_type_stats g ON g.move_type = s.move_type
    WHERE s.unit_price > g.avg_unit_price
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        move_type,
        warehouse_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouse_ids,
        ROUND(SUM(qty_minus_unit_price) / NULLIF(SUM(avg_unit_price), 0), 3) AS qty_minus_unit_price_to_avg_unit_price_ratio
    FROM outliers
    GROUP BY move_type, warehouse_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
    move_type,
    distinct_ids,
    row_count,
    distinct_warehouse_ids,
    qty_minus_unit_price_to_avg_unit_price_ratio,
    row_count + distinct_warehouse_ids AS row_count_plus_distinct_warehouse_ids
FROM per_group
ORDER BY distinct_warehouse_ids, row_count_plus_distinct_warehouse_ids
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("moved_at")) < F.lit("2025-03-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        (F.col("qty") - F.col("unit_price")).alias("qty_minus_unit_price"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("operator")), 1, 3).alias("operator_prefix"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("distinct_move_type_in_warehouse_id", F.size(F.collect_set("move_type").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id"))))
    .withColumn("warehouse_id_max_unit_price", F.max("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id")))
)

tagged = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("move_type_operator_prefix_label", F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("move_type"), F.col("operator_prefix")))
)

move_type_stats = (
    tagged
    .groupBy("move_type")
    .agg(F.avg("unit_price").alias("avg_unit_price"))
)

outliers = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(move_type_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.move_type") == F.col("s.move_type"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.unit_price") > F.col("g.avg_unit_price"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_unit_price",
        F.round(F.col("s.unit_price") - F.col("g.avg_unit_price"), 2).alias("unit_price_minus_avg"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    outliers
    .groupBy("move_type", "warehouse_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.countDistinct("warehouse_id").alias("distinct_warehouse_ids"),
        F.round(F.sum("qty_minus_unit_price") / F.nullif(F.sum("avg_unit_price"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("qty_minus_unit_price_to_avg_unit_price_ratio"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)
)

result = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "move_type",
        "distinct_ids",
        "row_count",
        "distinct_warehouse_ids",
        "qty_minus_unit_price_to_avg_unit_price_ratio",
        (F.col("row_count") + F.col("distinct_warehouse_ids")).alias("row_count_plus_distinct_warehouse_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy("distinct_warehouse_ids", "row_count_plus_distinct_warehouse_ids")
)
```

```sql
ranked AS (
```

```sql
        NTILE(5) OVER w_all_by_storey_no AS storey_no_quintile,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(district_code_or_unknown) OVER w_district_code) AS distinct_district_code_or_unknown_in_district_co,
        LAG(storey_no) OVER (PARTITION BY district_code ORDER BY floor_sqm NULLS LAST, id) AS prev_storey_no,
        SUM(floor_sqm) OVER (PARTITION BY district_code) AS district_code_sum_floor_sqm,
        floor_sqm - LAG(floor_sqm) OVER (PARTITION BY district_code ORDER BY floor_sqm NULLS LAST, id) AS floor_sqm_change,
        MIN(storey_no) OVER (PARTITION BY district_code) AS district_code_min_storey_no
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_all_by_storey_no AS (ORDER BY storey_no NULLS LAST, id), w_district_code AS (PARTITION BY district_code)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE floor_sqm_change < (SELECT MAX(floor_sqm_change) FROM ranked)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(district_code_or_unknown, 'ALL') AS district_code_or_unknown,
    storey_no_quintile,
    distinct_district_code_or_unknown_in_district_co,

    COUNT(*) AS western_vault

GROUP BY CUBE(district_code_or_unknown, storey_no_quintile, distinct_district_code_or_unknown_in_district_co)

```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_turrets
    .filter(F.array_contains(F.col("piston_code"), "garden"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "storey_no",
        "floor_sqm",
        F.coalesce(F.col("district_code"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("district_code_or_unknown"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("granite_monolith")), 1, 2).alias("street_line_prefix"),
    )
)

w_all_by_storey_no = Window.orderBy(F.col("storey_no").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_district_code = Window.partitionBy("district_code")
ranked = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "district_code",
        "district_code_or_unknown",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_all_by_storey_no).alias("storey_no_quintile"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("district_code_or_unknown").over(w_district_code)).alias("distinct_district_code_or_unknown_in_district_co"),
        F.lag("storey_no").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy(F.col("floor_sqm").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("prev_storey_no"),
        F.sum("floor_sqm").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code")).alias("district_code_sum_floor_sqm"),
        (F.col("floor_sqm") - F.lag("floor_sqm").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code").orderBy(F.col("floor_sqm").asc_nulls_last(), "id"))).alias("floor_sqm_change"),

        F.count("*").alias("western_vault"),
    )
    .select(

        "storey_no_quintile",
        "distinct_district_code_or_unknown_in_district_co",
        "district_code_list",
        "n_district_code_not_in_d02_d04",
        "western_vault",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

latest = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("browser", "country").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_last = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") <= F.col("s.started_at")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.event_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.duration_sec"))
)

cleaned = (
    with_last
    .filter(F.col("country").isNotNull() & (F.col("device") == "desktop"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "started_at") / 365.25).alias("years_since_started_at"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("country_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.hour("started_at").between(11, 19))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("duration_sec")))
    .withColumn("years_since_started_at_max_30d", F.max("years_since_started_at").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("started_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)))
)

kept = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.session_id") == 16), "left_anti")
)

cleaned_sessions = (

    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-05-29 08:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("years_since_started_at") * 1.15), 2).alias("years_since_started_at_adjusted"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("country_filled_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "years_since_started_at",
        "country_filled",
        "years_since_started_at_max_30d",
```

```sql
    -- Running and moving aggregates
```
```sql
    select
```

```sql
        lead(stage_width_m_bucket, 1) over (order by rn, id) as carousel_span,

    from deduped
    where concert_id is null

    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id, sale_channel
    from metrics_ticket_sales
    intersect

    from scaffold_dories

),

    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics_ticket_sales s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.sale_channel = k.sale_channel
),

    select src.*, c.act_name as concert_act_name
    from kept_rows src
    left join junctions c
        on src.concert_id = c.id

select

    case when act_name rlike '^(Blue Lanterns|Nova Kid)$' then 'GROUP_B' else 'EXTENDED' end as act_name_zone,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("show_status").orderBy("stage_width_m", "id")
set_minutes_by_concert_id = df_scaffold_dories.groupBy("concert_id").agg(F.max("set_minutes").alias("frescoe_rank"))

valid = (
    df_scaffold_dories
    .filter(F.col("show_status").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last_day("announced_on").alias("announced_on_month_end"),
        F.coalesce("show_status", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("show_status_filled"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "concert_id",
        "sale_channel",
        "act_name",
        F.corr("stage_width_m", "set_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("concert_id")).alias("corr_stage_width_m_set_minutes"),
        F.sum("set_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("sale_channel").orderBy("announced_on_month_end", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_set_minutes"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w_part).alias("stage_width_m_bucket"),
        F.avg("set_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("show_status").orderBy("set_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("set_minutes_avg_6"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("concert_id", "sale_channel").orderBy("stage_width_m_bucket", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics_ticket_sales = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("concert_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("stage_width_m_bucket", 1).over(Window.orderBy("rn", "id")).alias("carousel_span"),
        F.stddev_samp("stage_width_m_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("sale_channel")).alias("sale_channel_stddev_samp_stage_width_m_bucket"),

)

    .select("id", "sale_channel")
    .intersect(

        .filter(F.month("announced_on").isin([5, 6, 8]))
        .select("id", "sale_channel")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    metrics_ticket_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.sale_channel") == F.col("k.sale_channel")), "inner")

    .join(set_minutes_by_concert_id, on="concert_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "concert_id",
        "sale_channel",
        "act_name",
        "corr_stage_width_m_set_minutes",
        "running_set_minutes",
        "set_minutes_avg_6",
        "carousel_span",
        "sale_channel_stddev_samp_stage_width_m_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("act_name").rlike("^(Blue Lanterns|Nova Kid)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("act_name_zone"),
```

```sql
        student_id,
        course_id,

    FROM enrollments

    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at

flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        course_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_id, burst_id
),
with_details_course AS (

        )
)

    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    duration_min,
    course_code,
    YEAR(session_end) AS session_end_year,
    LENGTH(TRIM(course_code)) AS course_code_len
FROM filtered_2
```

```sql
        avg_play_ms_played_2,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY country, plan ORDER BY avg_play_ms_played_2, id) AS avg_play_ms_played_2_quartile,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY plan_group ORDER BY birth_year DESC, id) AS birth_year_quintile,
```

```sql
    GROUP BY student_id
)
SELECT

    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    a.withdrawn_total_score,
    COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    b.pass_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_student a
FULL OUTER JOIN pass_by_student b
  ON a.student_id = b.student_id
ORDER BY student_id
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "WITHDRAWN")

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.sum("score").alias("withdrawn_total_score"),

        F.count("*").alias("pass_count"),
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        venue_surface,
        minutes_played,
        sprint_kmh,
        flag_is_home,
        LOWER(TRIM(venue_surface)) AS venue_surface_clean
    FROM dim_venues
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        flag_is_home,
        venue_surface,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(venue_surface)) AS venue_surface_list,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        ROUND(AVG(minutes_played), 2) AS avg_minutes_played
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE venue_surface_clean IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY flag_is_home, venue_surface
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE avg_minutes_played < (SELECT MAX(avg_minutes_played) FROM rollup_base)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT flag_is_home, venue_surface, distinct_ids
    FROM screened
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(distinct_ids)
    FOR venue_surface IN ('grass', 'turf')
)
ORDER BY flag_is_home
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_dim_venues
    .select(
        "id",
        "venue_surface",
        "minutes_played",
        "sprint_kmh",
        "flag_is_home",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("venue_surface"))).alias("venue_surface_clean"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("venue_surface_clean").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("flag_is_home", "venue_surface")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("venue_surface")).alias("venue_surface_list"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("minutes_played"), 2).alias("avg_minutes_played"),
    )
)

screened = (
    rollup_base
    .crossJoin(rollup_base.agg(F.max("avg_minutes_played").alias("overall_max_avg_minutes_played")))
    .filter(F.col("avg_minutes_played") < F.col("overall_max_avg_minutes_played"))
    .drop("overall_max_avg_minutes_played")
)

result = (
    screened
    .groupBy("flag_is_home")
    .pivot("venue_surface", ["grass", "turf"])
    .agg(F.sum("distinct_ids"))
    .orderBy("flag_is_home")
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

    FROM flagged
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(quality), ' ', '_')) AS textile_ref,
        ABS(kwh - 86.0) AS jukeboxe_ref,
        voltage + kwh AS voltage_plus_kwh
    FROM steamers
    WHERE (HOUR(read_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 12 OR voltage < 237.5)
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching steamers
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_readings s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM steamers m
            WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id
              AND m.kwh BETWEEN 45.0 AND 117.4
        )
),
joined_site AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.kwh,
        s.quality,
        s.textile_ref,
        s.jukeboxe_ref,
        s.voltage_plus_kwh,
        si.zone AS site_zone,
        si.tariff AS site_tariff,
        si.commissioned_on AS site_commissioned_on
    FROM screened s
    LEFT JOIN daily_archives si ON si.id = s.site_id
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg kwh per site_id
    SELECT site_id, AVG(kwh) AS avg_kwh
    FROM joined_site
    GROUP BY site_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.avg_kwh, ROUND(s.kwh - g.avg_kwh, 2) AS inland_tanker
    FROM joined_site s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.kwh > g.avg_kwh
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per reading
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.quality,
        s.textile_ref,
        s.jukeboxe_ref,
        s.voltage_plus_kwh,
        s.site_zone,
        s.site_tariff,
        s.avg_kwh,
        m.id AS reading_id,
        m.kwh AS reading_kwh,
        m.read_at AS reading_read_at
    FROM vs_group s
    LEFT JOIN steamers m ON m.site_id = s.site_id AND m.kwh > 15.9
),
quality_stats AS (
    -- Median voltage_plus_kwh per quality
    SELECT quality, PERCENTILE_APPROX(voltage_plus_kwh, 0.5) AS median_voltage_plus_kwh
    FROM with_children
    GROUP BY quality
),
vs_group_2 AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_voltage_plus_kwh,
        ROUND(s.voltage_plus_kwh - g.median_voltage_plus_kwh, 2) AS voltage_plus_kwh_minus_median
    FROM with_children s
    JOIN quality_stats g ON g.quality = s.quality
    WHERE s.voltage_plus_kwh >= g.median_voltage_plus_kwh
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    read_at,
    quality,
    jukeboxe_ref,
    site_zone,
    site_tariff,
    avg_kwh,
    reading_id,
    reading_kwh,
    reading_read_at,
    median_voltage_plus_kwh,
    voltage_plus_kwh_minus_median,
    UPPER(TRIM(site_tariff)) AS site_tariff_clean
FROM vs_group_2
ORDER BY site_zone, read_at NULLS LAST
```

```sql
    FROM metrics

islands AS (

        event_type_avg_duration_sec,

gaps AS (

    FROM islands
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

with_dims = (
    df_emerald_lighthouses

)

    .filter(F.col("page") == "/home")
    .select(
        "*",

        F.lead("lighthouse_level", 1).over(Window.orderBy("event_time", "id")).alias("sprocket_tally"),
        F.avg("lighthouse_level").over(Window.orderBy("lighthouse_level", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_avg_2"),
        F.avg("lighthouse_level").over(Window.partitionBy("page")).alias("regional_chariot"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))

islands = (

    .select(

        "event_time",
        "country",
        "event_type_avg_duration_sec",
        "running_duration_sec",
        "sprocket_tally",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

result = (
    sessions_web_events
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "event_time").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "US", 1)).alias("us_rows"),
```

```sql
    WHERE claim_state = 'REVIEW'
    GROUP BY cover_contract_id
)

    COALESCE(a.cover_contract_id, b.cover_contract_id) AS cover_contract_id,
    COALESCE(a.denied_count, 0) AS denied_count,
    COALESCE(a.denied_avg_risk_score, 0) AS denied_avg_risk_score,
    COALESCE(b.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
    b.review_total_risk_score,
    COALESCE(a.denied_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.review_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM denied_by_cover_contract a
FULL OUTER JOIN review_by_cover_contract b
  ON a.cover_contract_id = b.cover_contract_id
ORDER BY cover_contract_id
```

```python
    df_loss_notices
    .filter(F.col("claim_state") == "DENIED")

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("denied_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("risk_score"), 2).alias("denied_avg_risk_score"),
    )
)

review_by_cover_contract = (
    df_loss_notices
    .filter(F.col("claim_state") == "REVIEW")
    .groupBy("cover_contract_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("review_count"),
        F.sum("risk_score").alias("review_total_risk_score"),
    )
)

    .join(review_by_cover_contract.alias("b"), F.col("a.cover_contract_id") == F.col("b.cover_contract_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.cover_contract_id"), F.col("b.cover_contract_id")).alias("cover_contract_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.denied_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("denied_count"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

enriched = (
    df_broadcasts
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "share_percent",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        "audience_tags",
        F.count("rating_pts").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart", "channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_rt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_rating_pts"),
        F.min("rating_pts").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart", "channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_rt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_rating_pts"),
        F.sum("rating_pts").over(Window.partitionBy("daypart", "channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_rt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_rating_pts"),
    )
)

prev_events = enriched.withColumn("prev_spot_aired_ts", F.lag("spot_aired_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id")))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_spot_aired_ts").isNull() | (F.col("spot_aired_ts") > F.col("prev_spot_aired_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "rating_pts",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        "audience_tags",
        "running_count_rating_pts",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

gaps_2 = (
    islands
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("spot_aired_ts") - F.lag("spot_aired_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps_2.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy("spot_aired_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "channels_tv_id",
        "spot_aired_ts",
        "program_title",
        "audience_tags",
        "session_start_flag",
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag").desc(), "id")).alias("session_start_flag_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("channels_tv_id").orderBy(F.col("spot_aired_ts").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("channels_tv_id", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_broadcasts
        .filter(~F.col("spot_type").isin(["promo", "psa"]))
        .select("channels_tv_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.channels_tv_id") == F.col("k.channels_tv_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_channels_tv.alias("c"), F.col("src.channels_tv_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .cube(F.col("c.panel_region").alias("panel_region"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.col("src.row_seq")).alias("total_row_seq"),
        F.min(F.col("src.session_start_flag_bucket")).alias("min_session_start_flag_bucket"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    a.outbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count,
    COALESCE(b.inbound_total_qty, 0) AS inbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM outbound_by_warehouse a
FULL OUTER JOIN inbound_by_warehouse b
  ON a.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id
ORDER BY warehouse_id
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "OUTBOUND")

        F.count("*").alias("outbound_count"),

    )
)

    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "INBOUND")

        F.sum("qty").alias("inbound_total_qty"),
    )

    .select(

        F.coalesce(F.col("a.outbound_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("outbound_count"),
        F.col("a.outbound_total_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.inbound_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("inbound_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.inbound_total_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("inbound_total_qty"),
```

```sql
        COUNT(row_seq) OVER w_part order_date_period_count_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id ASC) seq_no,
        MAX(running_carrier_length) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier) carrier_max_running_carrier_length,
        LEAD(discount_avg_2_prior, 1) OVER w_running next_discount_avg_2_prior
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date), carrier), w_running AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', shipped_date), carrier ORDER BY prev_cost_avg_6_prior ASC, id ASC)
```

```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "shipped_date"), "carrier").orderBy("prev_cost_avg_6_prior", "id")

    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-29")))

metrics = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id").orderBy(F.col("downtime_minutes").desc_nulls_last())

    .select(
        "id",
        "power_plant_id",
        "zone_code",
        "downtime_minutes",
        "commissioned_on",
        F.lag("downtime_minutes", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("zone_code", "power_plant_id").orderBy("inspected_date", "id")).alias("prev_downtime_minutes"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_recent).alias("downtime_minutes_dense_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("commissioned_on").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.stddev_samp("voltage_kv").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type")).alias("fuel_type_stddev_samp_voltage_kv"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("zone_code", "power_plant_id").orderBy(F.col("fuel_type_stddev_samp_voltage_kv").desc())).alias("emitter_code"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("power_plant_id").orderBy(F.col("downtime_minutes_dense_rank").desc(), "id")).alias("downtime_minutes_dense_rank_bucket"),
        F.stddev_samp("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("commissioned_on"), "zone_code")).alias("commissioned_on_year_stddev_samp_event_seq"),
    )
)

with_dims = (

    .alias("src")
    .join(df_fact_grottos.alias("p"), F.col("src.power_plant_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")

        F.round(F.avg("event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_event_seq"),

        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)

result = (

        "gas_commissioned_on_year_stddev_samp_event_seq",
```

```python
    df_data_sessions
    .filter((F.col("installed_on").between(F.lit("2024-10-12").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-07-08").cast("date"))) & (F.col("monthly_cap_gb") >= 17))
    .select(
        "id",
        "sim_card_id",
        "alarm_lvl",
        "monthly_cap_gb",
        "installed_on",
        "flag_is_esim",
        F.coalesce(F.col("monthly_cap_gb"), F.lit(0)).alias("monthly_cap_gb_filled"),
        F.date_format(F.col("installed_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("installed_on_label"),
    )

    .join(df_sim_cards.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.sim_card_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("si.alarm_raised_at").alias("sim_card_alarm_raised_at"),
        F.col("si.call_secs").alias("sim_card_call_secs"),
    )
)

    )
)

leaders = windowed.filter(F.col("seq_no") <= 2)

data_session_stats = (

    .groupBy("sim_card_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("alarm_lvl").isin("critical", "major"), 1)).alias("data_session_alarm_lvl_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("data_session_count"),

)

summarized_rows = (

    .join(data_session_stats.alias("d"), F.col("d.sim_card_id") == F.col("s.sim_card_id"), "left")

        F.coalesce(F.col("d.data_session_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("data_session_count"),

        F.sum("monthly_cap_gb_filled").alias("total_monthly_cap_gb_filled"),
```

```sql
derived AS (
```

```sql
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage) AS voltage_rank,

    FROM prepared_readings

profiled AS (

    SELECT

        (SELECT MAX(m.voltage) FROM polar_kayaks m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS max_reading_voltage
```

```sql
    FROM stats
```

```python
    df_bids
    .filter((F.col("moisture_percent") > 12.2) & (F.col("lot_grade_number") >= 1))
    .select(

        "commodity_lot_id",
        "bid_state",
        "lot_grade_number",

        F.month(F.col("bid_ts")).alias("bid_ts_month"),
    )

        "bid_state",
        "median_bid_ts_month",
        "n_rows",

    )
)

        "lot_grade_number",

        ids=["bid_ts_month", "lot_grade_number"],
        values=["median_bid_ts_month", "n_rows_quintile"],
```

```python
cleaned_claims = (
    df_chandlers
    .filter((F.col("maple_terrace") >= 4) | (F.year(F.col("claim_date")) == 2024))
    .select(
        "id",
        "marble_jukeboxe",
        "maple_terrace",
        "claim_type",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        (F.floor(F.col("claimed_amount") / 10000) * 10000).alias("claimed_amount_bucket"),
    )
)

derived = (
    cleaned_claims
    .select(

        F.when(F.col("claim_type").isin("collision", "medical"), "group_a").when(F.col("claim_type") == "fire", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("claim_type_group"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("reported_at")).alias("days_since_reported_at"),
    )
)

result = (

    .groupingSets(

    )
    .select(

        "grouping_level",
```

```sql
              AND b.lot_grade_number < 3

above_average AS (

    SELECT

    FROM screened s

FROM above_average
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_class_signups
    .filter(F.col("heart_rate_mean") > 85)
    .select(
        "id",
        "class_slot_id",
        "signup_state",
        "gym_area",
        "slot_capacity",
        "heart_rate_mean",
        "membership_fee",
        "session_started_ts",
        "coach_name",
    )
)

gym_area_stats = (
    recent
    .groupBy("gym_area")
    .agg(F.max("membership_fee").alias("max_membership_fee"))
)

compared = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(gym_area_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.gym_area") == F.col("s.gym_area"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.membership_fee") == F.col("g.max_membership_fee"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_membership_fee",
        F.round(F.col("s.membership_fee") - F.col("g.max_membership_fee"), 2).alias("membership_fee_minus_max"),
    )
)

derived = (
    compared
    .filter(F.col("membership_fee") > 50.2)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("heart_rate_mean") / F.nullif(F.col("max_membership_fee"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("heart_rate_mean_per_max_membership_fee"),
        F.when(F.col("slot_capacity") >= 30, "large").when(F.col("slot_capacity") >= 22, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("slot_capacity_tier"),
    )
)

class_slot_id_stats = (
    derived
    .groupBy("class_slot_id")
    .agg(F.max("heart_rate_mean").alias("max_heart_rate_mean"))
)

outliers = (
    derived.alias("s")
    .join(class_slot_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.class_slot_id") == F.col("s.class_slot_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.heart_rate_mean") == F.col("g.max_heart_rate_mean"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_heart_rate_mean",
        F.round(F.col("s.heart_rate_mean") - F.col("g.max_heart_rate_mean"), 2).alias("heart_rate_mean_minus_max"),
    )
)

detail_rows_class_signups = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(df_class_signups.alias("c"), F.col("c.class_slot_id") == F.col("s.class_slot_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.class_slot_id",
        "s.membership_fee",
        "s.coach_name",
        "s.membership_fee_minus_max",
        "s.max_heart_rate_mean",

        F.col("c.coach_name").alias("class_signup_coach_name"),
        F.col("c.slot_capacity").alias("class_signup_slot_capacity"),

        F.col("c.gym_area").alias("class_signup_gym_area"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    detail_rows_class_signups
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("coach_name")), " ", "_")).alias("coach_name_slug"),
        (F.col("membership_fee") + F.col("membership_fee_minus_max")).alias("membership_fee_plus_membership_fee_minus_max"),
    )
)

summary = (
    annotated
    .groupBy("class_slot_id", "class_signup_gym_area")
    .agg(
        F.sum("max_heart_rate_mean").alias("total_max_heart_rate_mean"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("class_signup_coach_name")).alias("class_signup_coach_name_list"),
        F.sum("class_signup_slot_capacity").alias("total_class_signup_slot_capacity"),
    )
)

enriched_class_slot = (
    summary.alias("s")
    .join(df_class_slots.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.class_slot_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.class_slot_id",
        "s.class_signup_gym_area",
        "s.total_max_heart_rate_mean",
        "s.class_signup_coach_name_list",
        "s.total_class_signup_slot_capacity",
        F.col("c.gym_id").alias("class_slot_gym_id"),
        F.col("c.gym_area").alias("class_slot_gym_area"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_class_slot
    .groupBy("class_slot_gym_id")
    .pivot("class_slot_gym_area", ["cardio", "free_weights"])
    .agg(F.sum("total_max_heart_rate_mean"))
)
```

```python
        F.coalesce(F.col("approved_amount"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("approved_amount_filled"),
    )
)

w_policy_id_claim_type_or_unkn_2 = Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "claim_type_or_unknown").orderBy("approved_amount_filled", "id")
w_claim_type_claim_type_or_unk = Window.partitionBy("claim_type", "claim_type_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("claimed_amount").desc())
w_claim_type_adjuster_id_by_cl_2 = Window.partitionBy("claim_type", "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("claimed_amount").desc(), "id")
```
