```python
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("approved_amount_filled") - F.avg("approved_amount_filled").over(w_adjuster_id), 2).alias("approved_amount_filled_vs_adjuster_id_avg"),
        F.first("claimed_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("claim_type", "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("claimed_amount").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_claimed_amount"),
        F.last("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "claim_type_or_unknown").orderBy("approved_amount_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_claimed_amount"),
        (F.col("claimed_amount") - F.lag("claimed_amount").over(w_policy_id_claim_type_or_unkn_2)).alias("claimed_amount_change"),
        F.round(F.col("approved_amount_filled") / F.nullif(F.sum("approved_amount_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "claim_type")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("approved_amount_filled_share_of_policy_id_claim_"),
        F.rank().over(w_claim_type_claim_type_or_unk).alias("claimed_amount_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_claim_type_adjuster_id_by_cl_2).alias("claimed_amount_rank_2"),
        F.round(F.col("claimed_amount") - F.avg("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id")), 2).alias("claimed_amount_vs_adjuster_id_avg"),
        F.last("approved_amount_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "claim_type_or_unknown").orderBy("approved_amount_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_approved_amount_filled"),

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_status).alias("rows_in_status"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("site_id") >= 9)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        F.quarter(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_quarter"),
    )
)

w_read_at_quarter = Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter")
w_all_by_read_at_ties = Window.orderBy("read_at")
windowed = (
    scoped_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "voltage",
        "read_at_quarter",
        F.min("read_at_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "read_at_quarter")).alias("site_id_read_at_quarter_min_read_at_quarter"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc())), 3).alias("read_at_cume_dist"),
        F.max("read_at_quarter").over(w_read_at_quarter).alias("read_at_quarter_max_read_at_quarter"),
        F.max("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)).alias("voltage_max_7"),
        F.max("voltage").over(w_read_at_quarter).alias("read_at_quarter_max_voltage"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh") / F.nullif(F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("kwh_share_of_read_at_quarter"),
        F.sum("voltage").over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("voltage_sum_2_prior"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter")).alias("rows_in_read_at_quarter"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.lag("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "read_at_quarter").orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("prev_kwh"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "read_at_quarter").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("kwh_avg_7"),
        (F.col("kwh") - F.lag("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id"))).alias("kwh_change"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_read_at_ties), 3).alias("read_at_percent_rank"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("read_at_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("kwh_change").desc(), "id")).alias("next_read_at_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("prev_kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter").orderBy(F.col("kwh_change").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prev_kwh"),
        F.max("kwh_share_of_read_at_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_quarter")).alias("read_at_quarter_max_kwh_share_of_read_at_quarter"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (

    .groupBy(
        "read_at_quarter",
        F.when(F.col("kwh_avg_7") >= 84.0, "A").when(F.col("kwh_avg_7") >= 24.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("kwh_avg_7_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("voltage") >= 237.5, "large").when(F.col("voltage") >= 222.3, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("voltage_tier"),

        F.round(F.stddev("site_id_read_at_quarter_min_read_at_quarter"), 2).alias("stddev_site_id_read_at_quarter_min_read_at_quart"),
    )
)

        "kwh_avg_7_tier",
        "site_id_read_at_quarter_min_read_at_quarter_to_p",
        "stddev_site_id_read_at_quarter_min_read_at_quart",
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

    FROM sessionized

    FROM sessions
    WINDOW w_all_by_n_events AS (ORDER BY n_events DESC, actor, session_no)
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
```

```sql
    FROM valid_cover_contracts

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_status ORDER BY filed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        claim_status,
        burst_id,
        MIN(filed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(filed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(filed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(filed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY claim_status, burst_id
),

    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY event_count, claim_status ORDER BY event_count, claim_status, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_burst_id,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_count, claim_status ORDER BY event_count, claim_status, burst_id), 3) AS event_count_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY event_count, claim_status, burst_id), 3) AS event_count_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_status ORDER BY duration_min DESC, claim_status, burst_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS burst_id_avg_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_count, claim_status ORDER BY event_count, claim_status, burst_id) AS event_count_seq
    FROM session_summary
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT claim_status, burst_id, metric_name, reading
FROM (
    SELECT claim_status, burst_id, running_burst_id, event_count, event_count_seq
    FROM windowed
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (running_burst_id AS running_burst_id_v, event_count AS m_event_count, event_count_seq AS event_count_seq_v)
) unp
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_cover_contracts = (
    df_cover_contracts
    .select(
        "id",
        "insured_id",
        "claim_status",
        "cover_kind",
        "risk_score",
        "premium_amt",
        "filed_at",
    )
)

with_prev = valid_cover_contracts.withColumn("prev_filed_at", F.lag("filed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("claim_status").orderBy("filed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_filed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("filed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_filed_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("claim_status").orderBy("filed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("claim_status", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("filed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("filed_at").alias("session_end"),

        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("event_count", "claim_status").orderBy("event_count", "claim_status", "burst_id")), 3).alias("event_count_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy("event_count", "claim_status", "burst_id")), 3).alias("event_count_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.avg("burst_id").over(Window.partitionBy("claim_status").orderBy(F.col("duration_min").desc(), "claim_status", "burst_id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("burst_id_avg_3"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("event_count", "claim_status").orderBy("event_count", "claim_status", "burst_id")).alias("event_count_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "claim_status",
        "burst_id",
        F.col("running_burst_id").alias("running_burst_id_v"),
        F.col("event_count").alias("m_event_count"),
```

```python
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("birth_year")).alias("birth_year_rank"),
```

```python
        F.trunc(F.col("promo_start_day"), "MM").alias("promo_start_day_month_start"),
        F.add_months(F.col("promo_start_day"), 6).alias("promo_start_day_plus_6m"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    annotated
    .filter(F.col("outlet_no") >= 18)
    .select(
        "id",
        "outlet_no",
        "visit_purpose",
        "outlet_format",
        "facings",
        "promo_lift_pct",
        "promo_start_day",
        "promo_lift_pct_minus_shrink_units",
        "promo_start_day_plus_6m",
        F.greatest(F.col("promo_lift_pct"), F.col("facings")).alias("greatest_promo_lift_pct_facings"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("promo_start_day_plus_6m").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("promo_lift_pct"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("promo_lift_pct_filled"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("promo_start_day_plus_6m")).alias("days_since_promo_start_day_plus_6m"),
    )
)

w_outlet_format = Window.partitionBy("outlet_format")
metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("promo_lift_pct_filled") - F.avg("promo_lift_pct_filled").over(w_outlet_format), 2).alias("promo_lift_pct_filled_vs_outlet_format_avg"),
        F.sum("facings").over(Window.partitionBy("visit_purpose", F.year("promo_start_day")).orderBy(F.col("days_since_promo_start_day_plus_6m").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_facings"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("visit_purpose").over(w_outlet_format)).alias("distinct_visit_purpose_in_outlet_format"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        "outlet_format",
        F.year("promo_start_day").alias("promo_start_day_year"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("days_since_promo_start_day_plus_6m").alias("total_days_since_promo_start_day_plus_6m"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 2)
)

result = (

    .select("outlet_format", "promo_start_day_year")
```

```sql
    FROM with_activity_2
    WINDOW w_tariff_by_valid_from_ties AS (PARTITION BY tariff ORDER BY valid_from ASC)

leaders AS (

    WHERE valid_from_dense_rank <= 3
```

```python
)

w_played_at_quintile_2_listene = Window.partitionBy("played_at_quintile_2", "listener_id").orderBy("ms_played", "id")
w_next_played_at_to_date_liste = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("next_played_at"), "listener_id")
with_windows = (
    top_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "ms_played",
        "device_slug",

        "rows_in_played_at_month_is_skipped",
```

```sql
WITH valid_teams AS (
    -- Filter dim_teams
    SELECT
        id,
        cloud_region,
        vm_family,
        vcpu_cnt
    FROM dim_teams
),
vm_family_stats AS (
    -- Avg vcpu_cnt per vm_family
    SELECT vm_family, AVG(vcpu_cnt) AS avg_vcpu_cnt
    FROM valid_teams
    GROUP BY vm_family
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_vcpu_cnt,
        ROUND(s.vcpu_cnt - g.avg_vcpu_cnt, 2) AS vcpu_cnt_minus_avg
    FROM valid_teams s
    JOIN vm_family_stats g ON g.vm_family = s.vm_family
    WHERE s.vcpu_cnt > g.avg_vcpu_cnt
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        vcpu_cnt_minus_avg - LAG(vcpu_cnt_minus_avg) OVER (ORDER BY avg_vcpu_cnt ASC, id) AS vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_change,
        ROUND(avg_vcpu_cnt / NULLIF(SUM(avg_vcpu_cnt) OVER w_vm_family, 0), 4) AS avg_vcpu_cnt_share_of_vm_family,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_avg_vcpu_cnt_ties AS avg_vcpu_cnt_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(avg_vcpu_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY avg_vcpu_cnt ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_avg_vcpu_cnt,
        MAX(vcpu_cnt_minus_avg) OVER (ORDER BY avg_vcpu_cnt ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_max_4
    FROM outliers
    WINDOW w_vm_family AS (PARTITION BY vm_family), w_all_by_avg_vcpu_cnt_ties AS (ORDER BY avg_vcpu_cnt ASC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    cloud_region,
    vcpu_cnt_minus_avg,
    avg_vcpu_cnt_share_of_vm_family,
    avg_vcpu_cnt_rank,
    last_avg_vcpu_cnt,
    vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_max_4,
    SUBSTRING(TRIM(vm_family), 1, 2) AS vm_family_prefix
FROM metrics
ORDER BY vcpu_cnt_minus_avg
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_teams = (
    df_dim_teams
    .select(
        "id",
        "cloud_region",
        "vm_family",
        "vcpu_cnt",
    )
)

vm_family_stats = (
    valid_teams
    .groupBy("vm_family")
    .agg(F.avg("vcpu_cnt").alias("avg_vcpu_cnt"))
)

outliers = (
    valid_teams.alias("s")
    .join(vm_family_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.vm_family") == F.col("s.vm_family"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.vcpu_cnt") > F.col("g.avg_vcpu_cnt"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_vcpu_cnt",
        F.round(F.col("s.vcpu_cnt") - F.col("g.avg_vcpu_cnt"), 2).alias("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg"),
    )
)

w_vm_family = Window.partitionBy("vm_family")
w_all_by_avg_vcpu_cnt_ties = Window.orderBy("avg_vcpu_cnt")
metrics = (
    outliers
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg") - F.lag("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg").over(Window.orderBy("avg_vcpu_cnt", "id"))).alias("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_change"),
        F.round(F.col("avg_vcpu_cnt") / F.nullif(F.sum("avg_vcpu_cnt").over(w_vm_family), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("avg_vcpu_cnt_share_of_vm_family"),

        F.last("avg_vcpu_cnt").over(Window.orderBy("avg_vcpu_cnt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_avg_vcpu_cnt"),
        F.max("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg").over(Window.orderBy("avg_vcpu_cnt", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_max_4"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "cloud_region",
        "vcpu_cnt_minus_avg",
        "avg_vcpu_cnt_share_of_vm_family",
        "avg_vcpu_cnt_rank",
        "last_avg_vcpu_cnt",
        "vcpu_cnt_minus_avg_max_4",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("vm_family")), 1, 2).alias("vm_family_prefix"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("vcpu_cnt_minus_avg").asc())
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped_broadcasts AS (
    -- Filter broadcasts
    SELECT
        id,
        channels_tv_id,
        daypart,
        spot_rt,
        spot_aired_ts
    FROM broadcasts
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous spot_aired_ts per daypart
    SELECT *, LAG(spot_aired_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_ts, id) AS prev_spot_aired_ts
    FROM scoped_broadcasts
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_spot_aired_ts IS NULL OR spot_aired_ts > prev_spot_aired_ts + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
grouped AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        is_new_session,
        ROUND(SUM(spot_rt) / NULLIF(SUM(session_id), 0), 3) AS spot_rt_to_session_id_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT daypart) AS distinct_dayparts
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY is_new_session
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY material_kind ORDER BY incident_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    material_kind,
    starts_session,
    session_id,
    GROUPING(material_kind) AS is_total_material_kind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CUBE(material_kind, starts_session, session_id)
ORDER BY material_kind NULLS LAST, starts_session NULLS LAST, session_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
    )
)

with_prev = valid_build_projects.withColumn("prev_incident_at", F.lag("incident_at").over(Window.partitionBy("material_kind").orderBy("incident_at", "id")))
```

```sql
    FROM meter_readings
),
with_prev AS (

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, session_id
)
SELECT
    site_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,
    DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS session_end_label,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', session_start) AS days_since_session_start
FROM per_session
WHERE site_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_start DESC, site_id
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | (F.col("read_at") > F.col("prev_read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
```

```sql
    FROM scoped_tour_packages s

with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(min_guide_staff_guide_rating / NULLIF(SUM(min_guide_staff_guide_rating) OVER w_tour_operator_no, 0), 4) AS min_guide_staff_guide_rating_share_of_tour_opera,
        LAST_VALUE(guide_staff_pkg_season_count) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY guide_staff_pkg_season_count, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_guide_staff_pkg_season_count
    FROM profiled
    WINDOW w_tour_operator_no AS (PARTITION BY tour_operator_no)

line_level AS (

        s.guide_rating_plus_review_likes,
        s.pay_status_clean,
        s.guide_staff_count,
        s.min_guide_staff_guide_rating,
        s.min_guide_staff_guide_rating_share_of_tour_opera,

        r.pay_state AS review_post_pay_state,

    FROM with_trends s

)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT

    MAX(guide_staff_count) AS max_guide_staff_count,
```

```python
        F.min("guide_rating").alias("min_guide_staff_guide_rating"),

w_tour_operator_no = Window.partitionBy("tour_operator_no")
with_trends = (

        F.last("guide_staff_pkg_season_count", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("guide_staff_pkg_season_count", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_guide_staff_pkg_season_count"),
    )
)

line_level = (

    .join(df_review_posts.alias("r"), (F.col("r.tour_package_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("r.reserved_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-25 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "left")
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        adjuster_name,
        team,
        level,
        CASE WHEN team IN ('Travel', 'Property') THEN 'group_a' WHEN team = 'Motor' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS team_group,
        ABS(level - 3) AS level_distance,
        LENGTH(TRIM(adjuster_name)) AS adjuster_name_len
    FROM adjusters
    WHERE adjuster_name IS NOT NULL
),
detail_rows_claims AS (
    -- One row per claim
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.team,
        s.team_group,
        s.level_distance,
        c.id AS claim_id,
        c.claimed_amount AS claim_claimed_amount,
        c.approved_amount AS claim_approved_amount,
        c.policy_id AS claim_policy_id,
        c.claim_type
    FROM recent s
    LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id = s.id
),
combined_details_policy AS (
    -- Join policies
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.team,
        s.claim_id,
        s.claim_claimed_amount,
        s.claim_approved_amount,
        s.claim_policy_id,
        s.claim_type,
        p.start_date AS policy_start_date,
        po.holder_name
    FROM detail_rows_claims s
    JOIN policies p ON p.id = s.claim_policy_id
    LEFT JOIN policyholders po ON po.id = p.holder_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM combined_details_policy
    WHERE claim_claimed_amount < (SELECT MAX(claim_claimed_amount) FROM combined_details_policy)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        YEAR(policy_start_date) AS policy_start_date_year,
        claim_id,
        team,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        ROUND(AVG(claim_claimed_amount), 2) AS avg_claim_claimed_amount,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(policy_start_date), MIN(policy_start_date)) AS policy_start_date_span_days,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(holder_name)) AS holder_name_list,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(team)) AS team_list,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(claim_approved_amount, 0.5) AS median_claim_approved_amount
    FROM qualified
    WHERE claim_approved_amount > 7204.1
    GROUP BY YEAR(policy_start_date), claim_id, team
    HAVING MAX(claim_approved_amount) > 0.0
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT policy_start_date_year, claim_id, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT policy_start_date_year, claim_id, median_claim_approved_amount, avg_claim_claimed_amount
    FROM grouped
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR field IN (median_claim_approved_amount, avg_claim_claimed_amount)
) unp
ORDER BY policy_start_date_year, claim_id, field
```

```python
recent = (
    df_adjusters
    .filter(F.col("adjuster_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "adjuster_name",

        "level",
        F.when(F.col("team").isin("Travel", "Property"), "group_a").when(F.col("team") == "Motor", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("team_group"),
        F.abs(F.col("level") - 3).alias("level_distance"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("adjuster_name"))).alias("adjuster_name_len"),
    )
)

detail_rows_claims = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(df_claims.alias("c"), F.col("c.adjuster_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")

        "s.id",
        "s.team",
        "s.team_group",
        "s.level_distance",
        F.col("c.id").alias("claim_id"),
        F.col("c.claimed_amount").alias("claim_claimed_amount"),
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
)

    event_at,
    event_type,
    event_type_ref,
    prev_event_at,
    session_no,
    CONCAT(event_type, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS event_type_ref_2
FROM sessionized
ORDER BY event_type_ref NULLS LAST, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
        F.greatest(F.col("voltage"), F.col("kwh")).alias("greatest_voltage_kwh"),
        (F.col("voltage") - F.col("kwh")).alias("voltage_minus_kwh"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        "quality_ref",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh",
        "voltage_minus_kwh",
        F.concat_ws("|", F.col("quality_ref"), F.col("quality")).alias("quality_ref_quality_label"),
        F.month(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_month"),
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("quality_ref"))).alias("quality_ref_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    tagged
    .filter(F.col("voltage_minus_kwh") >= 54.8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh",
        "read_at_month",
        "quality_ref_clean",

        F.round(F.col("greatest_voltage_kwh") * 1.5, 2).alias("greatest_voltage_kwh_adj"),
        F.round(F.col("greatest_voltage_kwh") / F.nullif(F.col("voltage_minus_kwh"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("greatest_voltage_kwh_per_voltage_minus_kwh"),
    )
)

w_read_at_month_quality_ref_le = Window.partitionBy("read_at_month", "quality_ref_len")
metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh",
        "read_at_month",
        "quality_ref_clean",
        "quality_ref_len",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh_per_voltage_minus_kwh",

        F.max("read_at_month").over(w_read_at_month_quality_ref_le).alias("read_at_month_quality_ref_len_max_read_at_month"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .crossJoin(metrics.agg(F.avg("read_at_month").alias("overall_avg_read_at_month")))
    .filter(F.col("read_at_month") > F.col("overall_avg_read_at_month"))

w_quality_ref_len_read_at_mont = Window.partitionBy("quality_ref_len", "read_at_month")
w_read_at_month_quality_ref_le_2 = Window.partitionBy("read_at_month", "quality_ref_len").orderBy(F.col("read_at_month").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
with_trends = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at_month",
        "quality_ref_clean",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh_per_voltage_minus_kwh",
        "read_at_month_quality_ref_len_max_read_at_month",

        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_read_at_month_quality_ref_le_2), 3).alias("read_at_month_percent_rank"),

        F.sum("quality_ref_len").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_ref_len", "read_at_month")).alias("quality_ref_len_read_at_month_sum_quality_ref_le"),
    )

with_activity = (

    .drop("overall_max_greatest_voltage_kwh_per_voltage_min")
)

result = (

        "read_at_month_quality_ref_len_max_read_at_month",

        (F.col("read_at_month_change") - F.col("read_at_month")).alias("read_at_month_change_minus_read_at_month"),
    )
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        trading_post_id,
        trader_kind,
        commodity,
        lot_grade_number,
        tick_volume,
        bid_at,
        flag_is_certified,
        HOUR(bid_at) AS bid_at_hour
    FROM commodity_lots
    WHERE tick_volume BETWEEN 119 AND 648
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        trading_post_id,
        trader_kind,
        commodity,
        bid_at,
        flag_is_certified,
        bid_at_hour,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(trading_post_id) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_kind, commodity)) AS distinct_trading_post_id_in_trader_kind_commodit,
        ROUND(AVG(bid_at_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bid_at) ORDER BY lot_grade_number ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS bid_at_hour_avg_1_prior,
        LAST_VALUE(tick_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bid_at) ORDER BY lot_grade_number ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_tick_volume,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number ORDER BY lot_grade_number, id) AS lot_grade_number_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(lot_grade_number) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number ORDER BY lot_grade_number, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS lot_grade_number_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(lot_grade_number) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number ORDER BY lot_grade_number, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_lot_grade_number
    FROM cleaned
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        trading_post_id,
        trader_kind,
        commodity,
        bid_at,
        flag_is_certified,
        distinct_trading_post_id_in_trader_kind_commodit,
        bid_at_hour_avg_1_prior,
        last_tick_volume,
        lot_grade_number_rank,
        lot_grade_number_avg_3,
        first_lot_grade_number,
        MAX(last_tick_volume) OVER w_trading_post_id AS trading_post_id_max_last_tick_volume,
        LEAD(first_lot_grade_number, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY distinct_trading_post_id_in_trader_kind_commodit, id) AS next2_first_lot_grade_number
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_trading_post_id AS (PARTITION BY trading_post_id)
),
enriched_trading_post AS (
    -- Join trading_posts
    SELECT s.*, t.lot_grade_no AS trading_post_lot_grade_no
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN trading_posts t ON t.id = s.trading_post_id
),
first_rows AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched_trading_post
    WHERE lot_grade_number_rank <= 2
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per price_tick
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.trading_post_id,
        s.trader_kind,
        s.bid_at,
        s.flag_is_certified,
        s.last_tick_volume,
        s.lot_grade_number_avg_3,
        s.trading_post_lot_grade_no,
        p.id AS price_tick_id,
        p.lot_tonnes AS price_tick_lot_tonnes,
        p.trader_type AS price_tick_trader_type,
        p.lot_listed_on AS price_tick_lot_listed_on,
        p.bid_state AS price_tick_bid_state
    FROM first_rows s
    LEFT JOIN price_ticks p ON p.commodity_lot_ref = s.id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    trading_post_id,
    flag_is_certified,
    lot_grade_number_avg_3,
    trading_post_lot_grade_no,
    price_tick_id,
    price_tick_lot_tonnes,
    price_tick_lot_listed_on,
    price_tick_bid_state,
    CASE WHEN price_tick_trader_type IN ('broker', 'mill') THEN 'group_a' WHEN price_tick_trader_type = 'exporter' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS price_tick_trader_type_group,
    COALESCE(price_tick_trader_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS price_tick_trader_type_or_unknown
FROM line_level
WHERE flag_is_certified = TRUE
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (

        session_no,
        MIN(spot_aired_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(spot_aired_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(spot_aired_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(spot_aired_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY daypart, session_no
)
SELECT
    daypart,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
WHERE event_count <= 4
```

```python
        "actor",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_policys = (
    df_policies
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "product",
        "start_date",
        "status",
    )
)

w_holder_id_by_start_date_ties = Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy("start_date")
w_status_by_start_date_ties = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date")
w_status_by_start_date = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date", "id")
sequenced = (
    recent_policys
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "start_date",
        "status",
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_holder_id_by_start_date_ties), 3).alias("start_date_percent_rank"),
        F.lag("start_date").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("prev_start_date"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date")).orderBy("start_date")).alias("start_date_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date")).alias("start_date_dense_rank"),
        F.nth_value("start_date", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("product", "status").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_start_date"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("start_date_rank_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date")).orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("start_date_dense_rank_2"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy("start_date")).alias("start_date_rank_3"),
        F.first("start_date").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_start_date"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_status_by_start_date_ties), 3).alias("start_date_percent_rank_2"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_status_by_start_date).alias("start_date_tercile"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    sequenced
    .groupBy(
        "start_date_dense_rank",
        F.year("first_start_date").alias("first_start_date_year"),
        "start_date_rank",
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("read_at") < F.lit("2025-02-24 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")) | (F.col("voltage") <= 233.1))
    .select(

        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        F.date_trunc("quarter", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_quarter"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    recent
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "read_at_quarter",

        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("EST", "BAD"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "OK", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("quality_group"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (

    .agg(
```

```sql
        t.event_type AS event_event_type,
        t.event_at AS event_event_at
    FROM scoped s

totals AS (
    -- Group-level totals
```

```python
scoped = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter((F.month(F.col("event_at")).isin(1, 3)) | (F.col("event_type").isNotNull()))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.when(F.col("actor").isin("system", "agent"), "group_a").when(F.col("actor") == "customer", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("actor_group"),
        (F.col("event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("event_at_plus_30m"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("event_type"), F.col("actor")).alias("event_type_actor_label"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), (F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.ticket_id")) & (F.col("t.event_at") >= F.lit("2025-02-06 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.ticket_id",
        "s.event_at",
        "s.event_at_plus_30m",
        "s.event_type_actor_label",
        F.col("t.id").alias("event_id"),
        F.col("t.actor").alias("event_actor"),
        F.col("t.event_type").alias("event_event_type"),
        F.col("t.event_at").alias("event_event_at"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_children
    .groupBy(F.year("event_at").alias("event_at_year"), "event_event_type")
    .agg(
        F.max("event_at").alias("last_event_at"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_event_type").isin("assigned", "created", "resolved"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_event_event_type_in_assigned"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("event_actor")).alias("event_actor_list"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("event_event_type")).alias("event_event_type_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_event_type").isin("resolved", "created"), 1)).alias("n_event_event_type_in_resolved"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") >= 2)
)

w_event_at_year = Window.partitionBy("event_at_year")
ranked = (
    totals
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("event_at_year").over(w_event_at_year), 2).alias("event_at_year_avg_event_at_year"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("event_event_type", "n_event_event_type_in_resolved").orderBy("n_event_event_type_in_assigned", "event_at_year", "event_event_type")).alias("n_event_event_type_in_assigned_rank"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("event_event_type").isin("resolved", "escalated", "replied"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("event_at_year") - F.col("cnt")).alias("event_at_year_minus_cnt"),
        F.greatest(F.col("event_at_year"), F.col("cnt")).alias("greatest_event_at_year_cnt"),
    )
)

w_n_event_event_type_in_assign_3 = Window.partitionBy("n_event_event_type_in_assigned").orderBy("n_event_event_type_in_resolved", "event_at_year", "event_event_type")
ranked_2 = (
    tagged
    .select(
        "event_at_year",
        "event_event_type",
        "n_event_event_type_in_assigned",
        "cnt",
        "event_event_type_list",
        "n_event_event_type_in_resolved",
        "event_at_year_avg_event_at_year",
        F.round(F.col("event_at_year") - F.avg("event_at_year").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_event_at"))), 2).alias("event_at_year_vs_last_event_at_month_avg"),
        F.nth_value("event_at_year_minus_cnt", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("n_event_event_type_in_assigned").orderBy("n_event_event_type_in_resolved", "event_at_year", "event_event_type").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_event_at_year_minus_cnt"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("n_event_event_type_in_assigned").orderBy("n_event_event_type_in_resolved")), 3).alias("n_event_event_type_in_resolved_percent_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_event_type").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_event_at")))).alias("distinct_event_event_type_in_last_event_at_month"),
        F.lead("greatest_event_at_year_cnt").over(w_n_event_event_type_in_assign_3).alias("next_greatest_event_at_year_cnt"),
        F.round(F.col("greatest_event_at_year_cnt") - F.avg("greatest_event_at_year_cnt").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_event_at"))), 2).alias("greatest_event_at_year_cnt_vs_last_event_at_mont"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked_2
    .select(
        "event_at_year",
        "event_event_type",
        "event_event_type_list",
        "n_event_event_type_in_resolved",
        "event_at_year_avg_event_at_year",
        "event_at_year_vs_last_event_at_month_avg",
        "n_event_event_type_in_resolved_percent_rank",
        "distinct_event_event_type_in_last_event_at_month",
        "next_greatest_event_at_year_cnt",
        "greatest_event_at_year_cnt_vs_last_event_at_mont",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("event_event_type")), 1, 2).alias("event_event_type_prefix"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("event_at_year"), F.lit(0)).alias("event_at_year_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("n_event_event_type_in_resolved").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
        id,
```
```sql
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
```

```sql
    FROM meter_readings
```

```sql
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        quality_clean,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_read_at AS read_at_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at)) AS rows_in_site_id_read_at_month,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_read_at_ties AS read_at_dense_rank,
        MAX(kwh_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS kwh_bucket_max_2_prior,
        COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        SUM(kwh_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS kwh_bucket_sum_1_prior
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_all_by_read_at AS (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id), w_all_by_read_at_ties AS (ORDER BY read_at DESC)
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        kwh,
        quality_clean,
        read_at_rank,
        rows_in_site_id_read_at_month,
        running_count,
        kwh_bucket_sum_1_prior,
        LENGTH(TRIM(quality)) AS quality_len,
        ROUND(kwh_bucket_max_2_prior / NULLIF(kwh, 0), 3) AS kwh_bucket_max_2_prior_per_kwh
    FROM ranked
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    quality_clean,
    read_at_rank,
    rows_in_site_id_read_at_month,
    running_count,
    kwh_bucket_sum_1_prior,
    quality_len,
    kwh_bucket_max_2_prior_per_kwh,
    LENGTH(TRIM(quality_clean)) AS quality_clean_len
FROM derived
ORDER BY read_at_rank
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-07-17 04:00:00"))) & F.col("order_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.round("amount", 1).alias("amount_rounded"),
        F.trim("method").alias("clean_method"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

filtered_payments = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-09-19").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_method"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered_payments
    .select("status")
    .intersectAll(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([12, 22, 32, 39]))
        .select("status")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("amount_int").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_int_avg_90d"),
        F.min("amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("paid_at"))).alias("paid_at_month_min_amount"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("paid_at")).orderBy(F.col("amount_rounded").desc())).alias("amount_rounded_dense_rank"),
        F.max("amount_rounded").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_rounded_max_7d"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.method",
        "a.amount_rounded",
        "a.amount_int",
        "a.resolved_method",
        "a.amount_int_avg_90d",
        "a.paid_at_month_min_amount",
        "a.amount_rounded_max_7d",
        F.col("p.status").alias("order_status"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("amount_rounded") >= 76, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_rounded_tier"),
        "order_id",
        F.when(F.col("amount_int_avg_90d") >= 68, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_int_avg_90d_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("order_status") == "PENDING", F.col("amount_int")).otherwise(0)).alias("pending_amount_int"),
```

```sql
    FROM meter_readings
```

```sql
    FROM recent

    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(m.reading_count, 0) AS reading_count,
        COALESCE(m.reading_count_2, 0) AS reading_count_2
    FROM without_matches s
    LEFT JOIN reading_stats m ON m.site_id = s.site_id
),
with_parent_site AS (
    -- Attach site attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.kwh,
        s.voltage,
        s.voltage_distance,
        s.reading_count,
        s.reading_count_2,
        si.installed_kw AS site_installed_kw
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
    WHERE si.installed_kw < 386.6
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    site_id,
    reading_count,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT site_id) AS distinct_site_ids,
    MAX(read_at) AS last_read_at,
    ROUND(AVG(reading_count_2), 2) AS avg_reading_count_2
FROM with_parent_site
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((site_id, reading_count), (site_id), ())
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_pupils = (
    df_pupils
    .filter((F.col("lesson_minutes") > 44) | (F.col("score_pct").between(17.4, 65.0)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "campus_id",
        "house_name",
        "subject_area",
        "lesson_minutes",
        "enrolled_on",
    )
)

subject_area_stats = (
    cleaned_pupils
    .groupBy("subject_area")
    .agg(F.avg("lesson_minutes").alias("avg_lesson_minutes"))
)

outliers = (
    cleaned_pupils.alias("s")
    .join(subject_area_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.subject_area") == F.col("s.subject_area"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.lesson_minutes") > F.col("g.avg_lesson_minutes"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_lesson_minutes",
        F.round(F.col("s.lesson_minutes") - F.col("g.avg_lesson_minutes"), 2).alias("lesson_minutes_minus_avg"),
    )
)

w_subject_area_campus_id = Window.partitionBy("subject_area", "campus_id")
w_subject_area_campus_id_by_en_2 = Window.partitionBy("subject_area", "campus_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_on").desc())
ranked = (
    outliers
    .select(
        "id",
        "campus_id",
        "house_name",

        "enrolled_on",
        "avg_lesson_minutes",
        "lesson_minutes_minus_avg",
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("subject_area", "campus_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_on").desc(), "id")).alias("enrolled_on_quartile"),
        F.sum("avg_lesson_minutes").over(w_subject_area_campus_id).alias("subject_area_campus_id_sum_avg_lesson_minutes"),
        F.round(F.col("lesson_minutes") / F.nullif(F.sum("lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("subject_area", "campus_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("lesson_minutes_share_of_subject_area_campus_id"),
        F.rank().over(w_subject_area_campus_id_by_en_2).alias("enrolled_on_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("avg_lesson_minutes") - F.avg("avg_lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("subject_area", "campus_id")), 2).alias("avg_lesson_minutes_vs_subject_area_campus_id_avg"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("house_name"))).alias("house_name_len"),
        F.when(F.col("house_name").isin("Gold", "Green"), "group_a").when(F.col("house_name") == "Blue", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("house_name_group"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("house_name")), " ", "_")).alias("house_name_slug"),

result = (
```

```sql
WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the vessels rows
    SELECT
        id,
        container_size,
        draft_m,
        berthed_at,
        COALESCE(teu_capacity, 0) AS teu_capacity_filled
    FROM vessels
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous berthed_at per container_size
    SELECT *, LAG(berthed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY container_size ORDER BY berthed_at, id) AS prev_berthed_at
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_berthed_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(berthed_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_berthed_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY container_size ORDER BY berthed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        container_size,
        session_no,
        MIN(berthed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(berthed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(teu_capacity_filled) AS session_teu_capacity_filled,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(berthed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(berthed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY container_size, session_no
)
SELECT container_size, session_no, field, reading
FROM (
    SELECT container_size, session_no, event_count, session_teu_capacity_filled
    FROM per_session
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    reading FOR field IN (event_count, session_teu_capacity_filled)
) unp
ORDER BY container_size, session_no, field
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_vessels
    .select(
        "id",
        "container_size",
        "draft_m",
        "berthed_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("teu_capacity"), F.lit(0)).alias("teu_capacity_filled"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_berthed_at", F.lag("berthed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("container_size").orderBy("berthed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_berthed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("berthed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_berthed_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("container_size").orderBy("berthed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("container_size", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("berthed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("berthed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("teu_capacity_filled").alias("session_teu_capacity_filled"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("berthed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("berthed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_session
    .select(
        "container_size",
        "session_no",
        "event_count",
        "session_teu_capacity_filled",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["container_size", "session_no"],
        values=["event_count", "session_teu_capacity_filled"],
        variableColumnName="field",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .orderBy("container_size", "session_no", "field")
)
```

```sql
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY move_type, sku_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM scoped_moves
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
exploded_detail_moves AS (
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned_broadcasts

flagged AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_spot_aired_ts_plus_15m IS NULL OR spot_aired_ts_plus_15m > prev_spot_aired_ts_plus_15m + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_ts_plus_15m, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session

        daypart,
        session_no,
        MIN(spot_aired_ts_plus_15m) AS session_start,
        MAX(spot_aired_ts_plus_15m) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(spot_aired_ts_plus_15m)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(spot_aired_ts_plus_15m))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

tagged AS (

        INITCAP(TRIM(daypart)) AS daypart_clean,
        COALESCE(event_count, 0) AS event_count_filled
    FROM sessions
    WHERE duration_min < 144.0
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(duration_min / NULLIF(session_no, 0), 3) AS duration_min_per_session_no,
        COALESCE(event_count_filled, 0) AS event_count_filled_filled
    FROM tagged
)
SELECT
    daypart,
    session_no,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_canals
    .filter((F.month(F.col("moved_at")).isin(1, 3)) & (F.col("warehouse_id") <= 2))

        F.col("sk.category").alias("sku_category"),
    )

w_operator = Window.partitionBy("operator")
sequenced = (
    with_details_sku
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("sku_unit_cost").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "canyon_mark").orderBy("moved_at", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("sku_unit_cost_max_1_prior"),

        F.round(F.col("prev2_unit_price") / F.nullif(F.sum("prev2_unit_price").over(w_distinct_move_type_in_wareho), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prev2_unit_price_share_of_distinct_move_type_in_"),

        (F.col("unit_price") - F.lag("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("warehouse_id_sku_id_avg_qty").desc(), "id"))).alias("unit_price_change"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("warehouse_id").over(w_distinct_move_type_in_wareho)).alias("distinct_warehouse_id_in_distinct_move_type_in_w"),
    )

result = (

    .filter(F.col("unit_price") >= 152.7)
    .select(

        "sku_id",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        "operator_move_type_label",
        "sku_unit_cost",
        "sku_labels",
        "sku_category",
        "sku_unit_cost_max_1_prior",
        "prev2_unit_price",
        "second_qty",

        "prev2_unit_price_share_of_distinct_move_type_in_",

        "min_sku_unit_cost_max_1_prior_so_far",
        "distinct_warehouse_id_in_distinct_move_type_in_w",
        F.when(F.col("operator").isin("op_chan", "op_dew"), "group_a").when(F.col("operator") == "op_bee", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("operator_group"),
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("read_at") < F.lit("2025-03-08 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(

        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_week"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_month"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("voltage").alias("min_reading_voltage"),
        F.min("kwh").alias("min_reading_kwh"),
        F.sum("voltage").alias("total_reading_voltage"),
    )

summarized_rows = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.min_reading_voltage",
        "m.min_reading_kwh",
        "m.total_reading_voltage",
    )
)

screened = (
    summarized_rows.alias("s")
    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left_semi")
)

w_read_at_week_month_site_id = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at_week"), "site_id")
sequenced = (
    screened
    .select(

        F.nth_value("total_reading_voltage", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("kwh").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_total_reading_voltage"),
        F.nth_value("total_reading_voltage", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_total_reading_voltage_2"),
        (F.col("min_reading_voltage") - F.lag("min_reading_voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("kwh").asc_nulls_last(), "id"))).alias("min_reading_voltage_change"),
```

```sql
WITH withdrawn_by_listing AS (
    -- WITHDRAWN rows per listing_id
    SELECT listing_id, COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_count, ROUND(AVG(bedroom_cnt), 2) AS withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt
    FROM offers
    WHERE listing_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
    GROUP BY listing_id
),
active_by_listing AS (
    -- ACTIVE rows per listing_id
    SELECT listing_id, COUNT(*) AS active_count, SUM(bedroom_cnt) AS active_total_bedroom_cnt
    FROM offers
    WHERE listing_status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY listing_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.listing_id, b.listing_id) AS listing_id,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt, 0) AS withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt,
    COALESCE(b.active_count, 0) AS active_count,
    b.active_total_bedroom_cnt,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.active_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_listing a
FULL OUTER JOIN active_by_listing b
  ON a.listing_id = b.listing_id
ORDER BY listing_id
```

```python
withdrawn_by_listing = (
    df_offers
    .filter(F.col("listing_status") == "WITHDRAWN")
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("bedroom_cnt"), 2).alias("withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt"),
    )
)

active_by_listing = (
    df_offers
    .filter(F.col("listing_status") == "ACTIVE")
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("active_count"),
        F.sum("bedroom_cnt").alias("active_total_bedroom_cnt"),
    )
)

result = (
    withdrawn_by_listing.alias("a")
    .join(active_by_listing.alias("b"), F.col("a.listing_id") == F.col("b.listing_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.listing_id"), F.col("b.listing_id")).alias("listing_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt"), F.lit(0)).alias("withdrawn_avg_bedroom_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.active_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("active_count"),
        F.col("b.active_total_bedroom_cnt"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.active_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```sql
    -- Filter fare_taps
    SELECT
        id,
        bus_route_id,
        stop_label,
        stop_seq,
        headway_minutes,
        route_opened_date,
        flag_has_shelter,
        FLOOR(headway_minutes / 10) * 10 AS headway_minutes_bucket
    FROM fare_taps
    WHERE stop_seq > 12
      AND bus_route_id IS NOT NULL
),
detail_rows_bus_stops AS (
    -- One row per bus_stop
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.bus_route_id,
        s.stop_label,
        s.stop_seq,
        s.headway_minutes,
        s.route_opened_date,
        b.id AS bus_stop_id,
        b.headway_minutes AS bus_stop_headway_minutes,
        b.tap_media AS bus_stop_tap_media
    FROM recent s
    JOIN bus_stops b ON b.bus_route_ref = s.bus_route_id AND b.headway_minutes BETWEEN 6 AND 44
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per bus_stop_tap_media
    SELECT
        id,
        bus_route_id,
        stop_label,
        stop_seq,
        headway_minutes,
        route_opened_date,
        bus_stop_id,
        bus_stop_headway_minutes,
        bus_stop_tap_media
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bus_stop_tap_media ORDER BY stop_seq DESC, id DESC, bus_stop_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM detail_rows_bus_stops
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT stop_label, bus_stop_tap_media, bus_stop_headway_minutes
    FROM unique_rows
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(bus_stop_headway_minutes) AS avg_v, SUM(bus_stop_headway_minutes) AS sum_v
    FOR bus_stop_tap_media IN ('qr', 'cash', 'card')
)
ORDER BY stop_label
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_fare_taps
    .filter((F.col("stop_seq") > 12) & (F.col("bus_route_id").isNotNull()))
    .select(

        "stop_seq",
        "headway_minutes",
        "route_opened_date",
        "flag_has_shelter",
        (F.floor(F.col("headway_minutes") / 10) * 10).alias("headway_minutes_bucket"),
    )
)

detail_rows_bus_stops = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(df_bus_stops.alias("b"), (F.col("b.bus_route_ref") == F.col("s.bus_route_id")) & (F.col("b.headway_minutes").between(6, 44)), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.bus_route_id",
        "s.stop_label",
        "s.stop_seq",
        "s.headway_minutes",
        "s.route_opened_date",

        F.col("b.headway_minutes").alias("bus_stop_headway_minutes"),
```

```sql
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY class_slot_id ORDER BY session_started_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

),
filtered AS (

    FROM filtered
)
SELECT

    session_end,
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    b.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```python
    df_dim_grid_zones

result = (
```

```sql
    SELECT western_mainframe, COUNT(*) AS colonie_rank, SUM(claimed_amount) AS pulley_mark
    FROM billboards
    WHERE status = 'PAID'
    GROUP BY western_mainframe
),
approved_by_adjuster AS (
    -- APPROVED rows per western_mainframe
    SELECT western_mainframe, COUNT(*) AS approved_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS approved_total_claimed_amount
    FROM billboards
    WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
    GROUP BY western_mainframe
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.western_mainframe, b.western_mainframe) AS western_mainframe,
    COALESCE(a.colonie_rank, 0) AS colonie_rank,
    a.pulley_mark,
    COALESCE(b.approved_count, 0) AS approved_count,
    COALESCE(b.approved_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS approved_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.colonie_rank, 0) - COALESCE(b.approved_count, 0) AS paid_count_minus_approved_count
FROM paid_by_adjuster a
FULL OUTER JOIN approved_by_adjuster b
  ON a.western_mainframe = b.western_mainframe
ORDER BY western_mainframe
```

```sql
        LAG(premium) OVER w_end_date_month_status_group AS prev_premium,
        NTH_VALUE(end_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', end_date), status_group ORDER BY premium, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_end_date
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_safety_incidents = (
    df_safety_incidents
    .filter(F.col("progress_percent") < 51.3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "build_project_id",
        "permit_status",
        "material_type",
        "progress_percent",
        (F.floor(F.col("crew_size") / 10) * 10).alias("crew_size_bucket"),
        F.hour(F.col("incident_ts")).alias("incident_ts_hour"),
    )
)

w_build_project_id_by_progress = Window.partitionBy("build_project_id").orderBy(F.col("progress_percent").desc())
w_build_project_id_permit_stat = Window.partitionBy("build_project_id", "permit_status").orderBy(F.col("progress_percent").desc(), "id")
w_build_project_id_by_progress_2 = Window.partitionBy("build_project_id").orderBy(F.col("progress_percent").desc(), "id")
with_trends = (
    valid_safety_incidents
    .select(
        "id",
        "build_project_id",
        "permit_status",
        "material_type",
        "crew_size_bucket",
        "incident_ts_hour",
        F.rank().over(w_build_project_id_by_progress).alias("progress_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("progress_percent").over(Window.partitionBy("incident_ts_hour")).alias("incident_ts_hour_sum_progress_percent"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_build_project_id_permit_stat).alias("progress_percent_quartile"),
        F.lag("incident_ts_hour").over(w_build_project_id_by_progress_2).alias("prev_incident_ts_hour"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("build_project_id", "permit_status").orderBy(F.col("progress_percent").desc())).alias("progress_percent_rank_2"),
        F.lead("progress_percent", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("build_project_id").orderBy(F.col("progress_percent").desc(), "id")).alias("next3_progress_percent"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("material_type").isin("cement", "glass", "steel"))
    .groupBy("prev_incident_ts_hour", "progress_percent_rank", "permit_status")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("permit_status") == "expired", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_permit_status_expired"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_incident_ts_hour"), 2).alias("avg_prev_incident_ts_hour"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("build_project_id").alias("distinct_build_project_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("n_rows") >= 2)
)

enriched = (
    grouped
    .filter(F.col("n_permit_status_expired").between(2, 6))
    .select(
        "prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "progress_percent_rank",
        "permit_status",
        "avg_prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "n_rows",
        F.when(F.col("n_permit_status_expired") >= 8, "large").when(F.col("n_permit_status_expired") >= 4, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("n_permit_status_expired_tier"),
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("permit_status"))).alias("permit_status_clean"),
    )
)

w_progress_percent_rank_by_n_r = Window.partitionBy("progress_percent_rank").orderBy("n_rows", "prev_incident_ts_hour", "progress_percent_rank", "permit_status")
with_trends_2 = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("permit_status", "prev_incident_ts_hour")).alias("rows_in_permit_status_prev_incident_ts_hour"),
        F.sum("progress_percent_rank").over(Window.orderBy("avg_prev_incident_ts_hour", "prev_incident_ts_hour", "progress_percent_rank", "permit_status").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_progress_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("avg_prev_incident_ts_hour", 1, 0).over(w_progress_percent_rank_by_n_r).alias("next_avg_prev_incident_ts_hour"),
        (F.col("n_rows") - F.lag("n_rows").over(Window.partitionBy("progress_percent_rank").orderBy("n_rows", "prev_incident_ts_hour", "progress_percent_rank", "permit_status"))).alias("n_rows_change"),
        F.lead("prev_incident_ts_hour").over(w_progress_percent_rank_by_n_r).alias("next_prev_incident_ts_hour"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_trends_2
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("n_permit_status_expired_tier").orderBy(F.col("next_avg_prev_incident_ts_hour").desc(), F.col("prev_incident_ts_hour").desc(), F.col("progress_percent_rank").desc(), F.col("permit_status").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "progress_percent_rank",
        "permit_status",
        "avg_prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "n_rows",
        "permit_status_clean",
        "rows_in_permit_status_prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "next_avg_prev_incident_ts_hour",
        "n_rows_change",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("next_avg_prev_incident_ts_hour").desc(),
        F.col("rows_in_permit_status_prev_incident_ts_hour").desc(),
    )
)
```

```python
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("salary", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("employee_job_title").orderBy("next_is_remote_flag", "id")

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-05-31").cast("date"))

        "full_name",
        "email",

        "job_title",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        F.lower("level").alias("level_lower"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("job_title_filled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(~F.col("is_remote"))
    .select("*", F.col("is_remote").cast("int").alias("is_remote_flag"))
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("next_is_remote_flag", F.lead("is_remote_flag").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("prev_is_remote_flag", F.lag("is_remote_flag").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("running_is_remote_flag", F.sum("is_remote_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_employees.alias("e"), F.col("a.manager_id") == F.col("e.id"), "left")

)

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_running))

    .withColumn("next_running_is_remote_flag", F.lead("running_is_remote_flag", 1).over(w_grp))

        "employee_job_title",
        "level",
```

```sql
        LAST_VALUE(guild_level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY willow_artisan ORDER BY guild_level DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_event_at
    FROM filtered_events

),
actor_stats AS (

    FROM sequenced
    GROUP BY actor
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2,
        ROUND(s.minutes_since_prev_event_at_2 - g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2, 2) AS minutes_since_prev_event_at_2_minus_avg
    FROM sequenced s
    JOIN actor_stats g ON g.actor = s.actor
    WHERE s.minutes_since_prev_event_at_2 > g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2

profiled AS (

    FROM above_average s

FROM profiled
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((actor, medallion_code, event_count), (actor), (medallion_code))
```

```python
filtered_events = (

        "actor",
    )
)

w_event_type_actor_by_event_at = Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan", "actor").orderBy("guild_level", "id")
sequenced = (

    .select(

        "medallion_code",
        "guild_level",
        "willow_artisan",
        "actor",
        F.nth_value("guild_level", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan").orderBy("guild_level", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_event_at"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("guild_level") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("guild_level").over(w_event_type_actor_by_event_at))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at"),
        F.lag("guild_level", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan", "actor").orderBy("guild_level", "id")).alias("prev2_event_at"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan").orderBy(F.col("guild_level").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("event_at_quartile"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("guild_level") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("guild_level").over(Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan").orderBy("guild_level", "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at_2"),
        F.last("guild_level", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("willow_artisan").orderBy(F.col("guild_level").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_event_at"),
    )
)

actor_stats = (
    sequenced
    .groupBy("actor")
    .agg(F.avg("minutes_since_prev_event_at_2").alias("avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2"))
)

above_average = (
    sequenced.alias("s")
    .join(actor_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.actor") == F.col("s.actor"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.minutes_since_prev_event_at_2") > F.col("g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2",
        F.round(F.col("s.minutes_since_prev_event_at_2") - F.col("g.avg_minutes_since_prev_event_at_2"), 2).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at_2_minus_avg"),

)

event_stats = (

profiled = (

        "s.*",
        "t.last_event_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.event_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("event_count"),

result = (
    profiled
    .groupingSets(

        "actor", "medallion_code", "event_count",

    .agg(
        F.grouping("actor").alias("is_total_actor"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("willow_artisan") == "resolved", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_event_type_resolved"),
    )
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("actor"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("actor"),
        "medallion_code",
        "event_count",
        "is_total_actor",
        "n_event_type_resolved",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("actor").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("medallion_code").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("event_count").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped AS (
    -- Scope the fixtures rows
    SELECT
        id,
        club_id,
        position_code,
        fixture_result,
        minutes_played,
        is_home,
        injury_codes,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', fixture_day) AS fixture_day_week,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(fixture_result), ' ', '_')) AS fixture_result_slug,
        DATE_FORMAT(fixture_day, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS fixture_day_label
    FROM fixtures
    WHERE fixture_result <> 'W'
),
with_details AS (
    -- Join clubs
    SELECT s.*, c.club_motto, c.fixture_day AS club_fixture_day
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN clubs c ON c.id = s.club_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN fixture_result IN ('W', 'D') THEN 'group_a' WHEN fixture_result = 'L' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS fixture_result_group,
        fixture_day_week + INTERVAL 7 DAYS AS fixture_day_week_plus_7d,
        DATE_FORMAT(club_fixture_day, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS club_fixture_day_label
    FROM with_details
    WHERE SIZE(injury_codes) >= 2
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach goal_events metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(g.signed_on) FROM goal_events g WHERE g.fixture_id = s.id) AS first_goal_event_signed_on,
        (SELECT MAX(g.sprint_kmh) FROM goal_events g WHERE g.fixture_id = s.id) AS max_goal_event_sprint_kmh,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goal_events g WHERE g.fixture_id = s.id) AS goal_event_count
    FROM enriched s
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per club_id
    SELECT
        id,
        club_id,
        position_code,
        fixture_result,
        minutes_played,
        is_home,
        injury_codes,
        fixture_day_week,
        fixture_result_slug,
        fixture_day_label,
        club_motto,
        club_fixture_day,
        fixture_result_group,
        fixture_day_week_plus_7d,
        club_fixture_day_label,
        first_goal_event_signed_on,
        max_goal_event_sprint_kmh,
        goal_event_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY club_id ORDER BY minutes_played DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM with_stats
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        club_id,
        position_code,
        minutes_played,
        is_home,
        fixture_day_label,
        club_fixture_day,
        fixture_result_group,
        fixture_day_week_plus_7d,
        first_goal_event_signed_on,
        CONCAT_WS('|', position_code, fixture_result) AS position_code_fixture_result_label
    FROM latest_per_key
),
per_group AS (
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("kwh") >= 16.5) & (F.col("site_id").isNotNull()))
    .select(

        "site_id",

        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        (F.col("voltage") + F.col("kwh")).alias("voltage_plus_kwh"),
        (F.col("kwh") + F.col("voltage")).alias("kwh_plus_voltage"),
        F.greatest(F.col("voltage"), F.col("kwh")).alias("greatest_voltage_kwh"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "quality",
        "voltage_plus_kwh",
        "kwh_plus_voltage",
        "greatest_voltage_kwh",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc())).alias("read_at_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("greatest_voltage_kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("voltage_plus_kwh", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("greatest_voltage_kwh_avg_2"),
        F.max("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("kwh_plus_voltage").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_kwh_so_far"),

)

sequenced = (

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy(F.month("commissioned_on_month_end"), "fuel_type").orderBy(F.col("downtime_minutes").desc())

valid = (
    df_ref_binders
    .filter(F.col("commissioned_on") > F.lit("2023-08-27").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last_day("commissioned_on").alias("commissioned_on_month_end"),
        F.when(F.col("downtime_minutes") >= 365, "High").when(F.col("downtime_minutes") >= 137, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("downtime_minutes_tier"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "fuel_type",
        "downtime_minutes",
        "commissioned_on",
        "commissioned_on_month_end",
        "downtime_minutes_tier",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("downtime_minutes_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("downtime_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("commissioned_on_month_end")).orderBy("commissioned_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_downtime_minutes"),
        F.avg("downtime_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("commissioned_on", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy(F.col("commissioned_on").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("fuel_type").orderBy("downtime_minutes", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(

        "commissioned_on_month_end",
        "downtime_minutes_tier",
        "downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior",
        "event_seq",

)

enriched = (

    .filter(F.col("event_seq") != 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("event_seq").over(Window.orderBy("downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("event_seq_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id")).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior").desc_nulls_first())).alias("downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior_cume_dist"),
        F.lag("downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior", 2).over(Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id")).alias("prev_downtime_minutes_avg_6_prior"),
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.car_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
    -- Events that happened while the ticket was open
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.ticket_id,
        e.event_at,

),
sequenced AS (

    SELECT
        *,

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY hours_since_open DESC, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_event_at
    FROM joined_ranges
    WINDOW w_priority_by_hours_since_open AS (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY hours_since_open DESC)
),
with_details AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.ticket_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.priority,
        s.agent_id,
        s.hours_since_open,
        s.hours_since_open_percent_rank,
        s.minutes_since_prev_event_at,
        su.team AS agent_team
    FROM sequenced s
    LEFT JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
)

    ticket_id,
    priority,
    agent_id,
    hours_since_open,
    minutes_since_prev_event_at,

FROM with_details
ORDER BY id DESC, priority DESC
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

joined_ranges = (
    df_ticket_events.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_tickets.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.ticket_id"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.ticket_id",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
```
