```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), event_time) / 365.25 AS years_since_event_time,
        COALESCE(page, 'OTHER') AS resolved_page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= '2025-09-01'
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM filtered
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 476 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS duration_sec_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/checkout' THEN 1 END) AS checkout_count,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_seen,
    BIT_OR(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_or,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    BIT_AND(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_and
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 476 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("event_time") >= "2025-09-01")
    .withColumn("years_since_event_time", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "event_time") / 365.25))
    .withColumn("resolved_page", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

with_gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 476, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("duration_sec_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/checkout", 1)).alias("checkout_count"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_seen"),
        F.bit_or("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_or"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.bit_and("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_bit_and"),
    )
)
```

```python
valid_pupils = (
    df_pupils
    .select(

        "campus_id",
        "house_name",
        "lesson_minutes",
        "score_pct",
        "enrolled_on",
    )
)

w_campus_id_enrolled_on_month = Window.partitionBy("campus_id", F.month("enrolled_on")).orderBy("lesson_minutes", "id")
with_windows = (
    valid_pupils
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("lesson_minutes").over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_lesson_minutes"),
        F.round(F.col("lesson_minutes") - F.avg("lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("campus_id", "house_name")), 2).alias("lesson_minutes_vs_campus_id_house_name_avg"),
        F.last("score_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("score_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_score_pct"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_on", "id")).alias("enrolled_on_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("campus_id", F.month("enrolled_on")).orderBy("lesson_minutes", "id")).alias("lesson_minutes_dense_rank"),
        F.lead("enrolled_on", 2).over(Window.orderBy("score_pct", "id")).alias("next2_enrolled_on"),
        (F.col("score_pct") - F.lag("score_pct").over(w_campus_id_enrolled_on_month)).alias("score_pct_change"),
    )
)

top_rows = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("lesson_minutes_dense_rank") <= 3)
    .drop("lesson_minutes_dense_rank")
)

w_enrolled_on_dense_rank = Window.partitionBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank")
metrics = (
    top_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "lesson_minutes",
        "score_pct",
        "enrolled_on",
        "first_lesson_minutes",
        "last_known_score_pct",
        "enrolled_on_dense_rank",
        "next2_enrolled_on",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank")).alias("rows_in_enrolled_on_dense_rank"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("next2_enrolled_on")).orderBy(F.col("lesson_minutes").desc(), "id")).alias("lesson_minutes_decile"),
        F.round(F.avg("enrolled_on_dense_rank").over(w_enrolled_on_dense_rank), 2).alias("enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg_enrolled_on_dense_ran"),
        F.lag("next2_enrolled_on").over(Window.partitionBy("campus_id", F.year("enrolled_on")).orderBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank", "id")).alias("prev_next2_enrolled_on"),
        F.round(F.col("score_pct_change") - F.avg("score_pct_change").over(Window.partitionBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank")), 2).alias("score_pct_change_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("lesson_minutes") - F.avg("lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank")), 2).alias("lesson_minutes_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg"),
        F.lead("lesson_minutes", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("campus_id", F.year("enrolled_on")).orderBy("enrolled_on_dense_rank", "id")).alias("next2_lesson_minutes"),
    )
)

summary = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_on").alias("enrolled_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("first_lesson_minutes").alias("total_first_lesson_minutes"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum("lesson_minutes_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg").alias("sum_lesson_minutes_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_lesson_minutes_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg") > -60.0)
    .drop("sum_lesson_minutes_vs_enrolled_on_dense_rank_avg")
)

sequenced = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("cnt").orderBy("total_first_lesson_minutes", "enrolled_on_month")).alias("rn"),
        F.max("cnt").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt").orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "enrolled_on_month").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("cnt_max_2_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("total_first_lesson_minutes") - F.avg("total_first_lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt")), 2).alias("total_first_lesson_minutes_vs_cnt_avg"),
        F.max("total_first_lesson_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt")).alias("cnt_max_total_first_lesson_minutes"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "enrolled_on_month",
        "total_first_lesson_minutes",
        "cnt",
        "rn",
        "cnt_max_2_prior",
        "total_first_lesson_minutes_vs_cnt_avg",
        F.date_format(F.col("enrolled_on_month"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("enrolled_on_month_label"),
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("enrolled_on_month")).alias("enrolled_on_month_hour"),
    )

)
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "s.site_id",
        "s.read_at",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.voltage",
        "s.quality",
        "si.site_name",
    )
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        tags,
        CASE WHEN channel IN ('phone', 'web') THEN 'group_a' WHEN channel = 'chat' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS channel_group
    FROM tickets
    WHERE NOT ARRAY_CONTAINS(tags, 'upgrade')
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per priority
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS prev_closed_at
    FROM filtered_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > prev_closed_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        closed_at,
        channel,
        new_session_flag,
        session_id,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(priority) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id)) AS distinct_priority_in_session_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY new_session_flag, MONTH(closed_at) ORDER BY closed_at ASC) AS closed_at_rank,
        ROUND(new_session_flag / NULLIF(SUM(new_session_flag) OVER w_session_id, 0), 4) AS new_session_flag_share_of_session_id,
        NTH_VALUE(prev_closed_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY new_session_flag, MONTH(closed_at) ORDER BY closed_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_prev_closed_at
    FROM sessionized
    WINDOW w_session_id AS (PARTITION BY session_id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    requester_id,
    closed_at,
    new_session_flag,
    distinct_priority_in_session_id,
    closed_at_rank,
    new_session_flag_share_of_session_id,
    second_prev_closed_at,
    CASE WHEN channel IN ('phone', 'email') THEN 'group_a' WHEN channel = 'chat' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS channel_group
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY closed_at_rank
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("course_id") <= 4) | (F.col("score").between(5.6, 59.8)))
    .select(

        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        F.concat(F.col("term"), F.lit("#"), F.col("student_id").cast("string")).alias("term_ref"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("grade_status"))).alias("grade_status_len"),
```

```sql
    FROM loans
    WHERE copies_owned < 9

    SELECT *, LAG(checked_out_at) OVER (PARTITION BY patron_no ORDER BY checked_out_at, id) AS prev_checked_out_at
    FROM prepared_loans

flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_checked_out_at IS NULL OR checked_out_at > prev_checked_out_at + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY patron_no ORDER BY checked_out_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        patron_no,
        session_id,
        MIN(checked_out_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(checked_out_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(checked_out_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(checked_out_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY patron_no, session_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach loans metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN l.patron_tier = 'senior' THEN 1 END) FROM loans l WHERE l.patron_no = s.patron_no) AS loan_patron_tier_count
    FROM sessions s
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns

        patron_no,
        session_id,
        session_start,
        events,
        loan_patron_tier_count,
        ABS(loan_patron_tier_count - 3) AS loan_patron_tier_count_distance
    FROM profiled
    WHERE loan_patron_tier_count < 7
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    patron_no,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    events,
    loan_patron_tier_count + events AS loan_patron_tier_count_plus_events,
    LEAST(session_id, events) AS least_session_id_events
FROM derived
ORDER BY events
```

```python
    df_loans

        "patron_no",
        "partner_kind",
        "patron_tier",
        "checked_out_at",
    )
)

with_prev = prepared_loans.withColumn("prev_checked_out_at", F.lag("checked_out_at").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_no").orderBy("checked_out_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_checked_out_at").isNull() | (F.col("checked_out_at") > F.col("prev_checked_out_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_no").orderBy("checked_out_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("patron_no", "session_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("checked_out_at").alias("session_end"),

        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "events",
        "loan_patron_tier_count",

    )
)

result = (
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY unit_state ORDER BY outage_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

session_summary AS (

        MAX(outage_started_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(outage_started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(outage_started_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY unit_state, session_id
)

    session_id,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    duration_min,
    QUARTER(session_start) AS session_start_quarter
```

```sql
    -- OPEN rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS open_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS open_total_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)

rejected_monthly AS (
    -- REJECTED rows per claim_date_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date) AS claim_date_month, COUNT(*) AS rejected_count, ROUND(AVG(claimed_amount), 2) AS rejected_avg_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'REJECTED'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    COALESCE(a.open_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    b.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rejected_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM open_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN rejected_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month
```

```python
open_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("open_total_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

rejected_monthly = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "REJECTED")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date").alias("claim_date_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rejected_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("claimed_amount"), 2).alias("rejected_avg_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    open_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(rejected_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.claim_date_month") == F.col("b.claim_date_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
```

```sql
    FROM towers_hist

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM scoped_tickets

flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        channel,
        session_no,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS lighthouse_code
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY channel, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    channel,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_requester_id,
    lighthouse_code,
    COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_or_unknown,
    session_no + event_count AS session_no_plus_event_count
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_start, channel, session_no
LIMIT 20
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.green_total_score_percent, 0) AS green_total_score_percent,
    COALESCE(b.blue_count, 0) AS blue_count,
    b.marble_steamer,
    COALESCE(a.green_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.blue_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM green_by_campus a
FULL OUTER JOIN blue_by_campus b
  ON a.campus_id = b.campus_id
ORDER BY campus_id
```

```python
    df_stg_anvils
    .filter(F.col("house_label") == "Green")

    .groupBy("campus_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("blue_count"),

    )
)

        F.coalesce(F.col("a.green_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("green_count"),

        F.coalesce(F.col("b.blue_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("blue_count"),
```

```sql
    s.id,
```

```sql
    s.shipped_date,

    s.status,
    s.prev_cost,
    s.prev_cost_2,
    s.cost_bucket,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(LOST|DELIVERED)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN status RLIKE '^(IN_TRANSIT|RETURNED)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS status_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(p2.amount) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.order_id = s.order_id) AS max_payment_amount
```

```sql
        built_on

    FROM cleaned_voyages

    SELECT
        CASE WHEN gross_tonnage >= 143970 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN gross_tonnage >= 49470 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS gross_tonnage_tier,
        MAX(days_since_built_on) AS max_days_since_built_on,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        MIN(gross_tonnage_distance) AS min_gross_tonnage_distance,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(built_on), MIN(built_on)) AS built_on_span_days
    FROM scored
    WHERE built_on < DATE '2025-06-06'
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN gross_tonnage >= 143970 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN gross_tonnage >= 49470 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END
),
filtered AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM rollup_base
    WHERE max_days_since_built_on > (SELECT AVG(max_days_since_built_on) FROM rollup_base)
)
SELECT gross_tonnage_tier, metric, amount
FROM (
    SELECT gross_tonnage_tier, min_gross_tonnage_distance, built_on_span_days, n_rows, max_days_since_built_on
    FROM filtered
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR metric IN (min_gross_tonnage_distance AS min_gross_tonnage_distance_v, built_on_span_days AS built_on_span_days_v, n_rows AS n_rows_v, max_days_since_built_on AS max_days_since_built_on_v)
```

```python
cleaned_voyages = (
    df_voyages
    .filter((F.col("crew_role") == "rating") & (F.col("built_on").between(F.lit("2024-09-19").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-08-02").cast("date"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "vessel_id",
        "crew_role",
        "vessel_flag",
        "gross_tonnage",
        "built_on",
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned_voyages
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("built_on")).alias("days_since_built_on"),
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("crew_role"))).alias("crew_role_clean"),
        F.abs(F.col("gross_tonnage") - 41470).alias("gross_tonnage_distance"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("built_on") < F.lit("2025-06-06").cast("date"))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("gross_tonnage") >= 143970, "HIGH").when(F.col("gross_tonnage") >= 49470, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("gross_tonnage_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("days_since_built_on").alias("max_days_since_built_on"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),

        F.datediff(F.max("built_on"), F.min("built_on")).alias("built_on_span_days"),
    )

filtered = (
    rollup_base
    .crossJoin(rollup_base.agg(F.avg("max_days_since_built_on").alias("overall_avg_max_days_since_built_on")))
    .filter(F.col("max_days_since_built_on") > F.col("overall_avg_max_days_since_built_on"))
    .drop("overall_avg_max_days_since_built_on")
)

result = (

    .select(
        "gross_tonnage_tier",
        F.col("min_gross_tonnage_distance").alias("min_gross_tonnage_distance_v"),
        F.col("built_on_span_days").alias("built_on_span_days_v"),
        F.col("n_rows").alias("n_rows_v"),
        F.col("max_days_since_built_on").alias("max_days_since_built_on_v"),
```

```sql
            WHERE p.holder_id = s.id
              AND p.status IS NOT NULL

),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE risk_score > (SELECT MIN(risk_score) FROM with_activity)
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT joined_on, segment, risk_score
    FROM screened
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS rare_count,

    COALESCE(a.common_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS net_count

  ON a.registered_on_month = b.registered_on_month
```

```sql
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(picker_cd) LIKE '%-4%' THEN lift_hrs ELSE 0 END) AS lift_hrs_lower_picker_cd_like_4,
```

```python
scoped_pick_tasks = (
    df_tbl_fiddles
    .filter(F.col("pallet_status").isin("shipped", "staged"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouses_v_id",
        "dock_side",
        "lift_hrs",
        "slot_start_ts",
        "picker_cd",
        "canal_level",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("slot_start_ts")).alias("lattice_span"),
    )
)

warehouses_v_id_stats = (
    scoped_pick_tasks
    .groupBy("warehouses_v_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("lift_hrs", 0.5).alias("median_lift_hrs"))
)

compared = (
    scoped_pick_tasks.alias("s")
    .join(warehouses_v_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.warehouses_v_id") == F.col("s.warehouses_v_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.lift_hrs") >= F.col("g.median_lift_hrs"))

profiled = (

    .select(
        "s.*",
        "p.avg_pallet_pallet_kilos",
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.pallet_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("pallet_count"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_bank_branches = (
    df_bank_branches
    .filter(F.col("txn_cnt") >= 295)
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_cnt",
        "drawer_balance",
        "decided_on",
        F.round(F.col("txn_cnt") / F.nullif(F.col("drawer_balance"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("txn_cnt_per_drawer_balance"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    prepared_bank_branches
    .crossJoin(prepared_bank_branches.agg(F.max("drawer_balance").alias("overall_max_drawer_balance")))
    .filter(F.col("drawer_balance") < F.col("overall_max_drawer_balance"))
    .drop("overall_max_drawer_balance")
)

detail_rows = (
    qualified.alias("s")
    .join(df_loan_apps.alias("l"), F.col("l.bank_branche_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.txn_cnt",
        "s.drawer_balance",
        "s.decided_on",
        F.col("l.id").alias("loan_app_id"),
        F.col("l.teller_grade").alias("loan_app_teller_grade"),
        F.col("l.atm_cash_level").alias("loan_app_atm_cash_level"),
    )
)

teller_stats = (
    df_tellers
    .groupBy("bank_branche_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("applied_on").alias("first_teller_applied_on"),
        F.round(F.avg("txn_cnt"), 2).alias("avg_teller_txn_cnt"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    detail_rows.alias("s")
    .join(teller_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.bank_branche_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.first_teller_applied_on", "t.avg_teller_txn_cnt")
)

teller_stats_2 = (
    df_tellers
    .groupBy("bank_branche_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("teller_count"))
)

with_counts = (
    profiled.alias("s")
    .join(teller_stats_2.alias("t"), F.col("t.bank_branche_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.teller_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("teller_count"),

)

w_teller_count = Window.partitionBy("teller_count")
ranked = (

    .select(

        F.last("decided_on").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("decided_on")).orderBy("txn_cnt", "id", "loan_app_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_decided_on"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupingSets(
        [["loan_app_id", "teller_count"], ["loan_app_id"], ["teller_count"], []],
```

```sql
annotated AS (
```

```sql
),
verified AS (
```

```sql
    FROM grouped

tagged AS (

    SELECT *, LENGTH(TRIM(specimen_type_group)) AS specimen_type_group_len
    FROM scored

unique_rows AS (

    SELECT

        specimen_type_group,
        specimen_type_group_len
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,

    FROM unique_rows

    value FOR metric IN (n_assay_kind_is_not_null AS m_n_assay_kind_is_not_null, specimen_type_group_len AS m_specimen_type_group_len, median_run_minutes AS comet_grade)
```

```sql
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY service_length DESC, id, key) AS rn

    ) t

    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS num_levels,
    AVG(service_length) FILTER (WHERE level = 'DEBUG') AS debug_avg_service_length,
```

```python
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.upper("service").alias("service_upper"),
    )
)

filtered_app_logs = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.coalesce("key", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("key_filled"))
```

```sql
    FROM enriched
```

```sql
ranked AS (

    SELECT
```

```sql
        last_known_latency_ms,
        row_seq
```

```sql
    -- won rows per commodity_lot_ref
    SELECT commodity_lot_ref, COUNT(*) AS won_count, SUM(lot_tonnes) AS won_total_lot_tonnes
    FROM tugboat_debuts
    WHERE bid_state = 'won'
    GROUP BY commodity_lot_ref
),
lost_by_commodity_lot_ref AS (
    -- lost rows per commodity_lot_ref
    SELECT commodity_lot_ref, COUNT(*) AS polar_adapter, ROUND(AVG(lot_tonnes), 2) AS lost_avg_lot_tonnes
    FROM tugboat_debuts
    WHERE bid_state = 'lost'
    GROUP BY commodity_lot_ref
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.commodity_lot_ref, b.commodity_lot_ref) AS commodity_lot_ref,
    COALESCE(a.won_count, 0) AS won_count,
    a.won_total_lot_tonnes,
    COALESCE(b.polar_adapter, 0) AS polar_adapter,
    b.lost_avg_lot_tonnes,
    COALESCE(a.won_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.polar_adapter, 0) AS net_count
FROM won_by_commodity_lot_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN lost_by_commodity_lot_ref b
  ON a.commodity_lot_ref = b.commodity_lot_ref
ORDER BY commodity_lot_ref
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

won_by_commodity_lot_ref = (
    df_tugboat_debuts
    .filter(F.col("bid_state") == "won")
    .groupBy("commodity_lot_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("won_count"),
        F.sum("lot_tonnes").alias("won_total_lot_tonnes"),
    )
)

lost_by_commodity_lot_ref = (
    df_tugboat_debuts
    .filter(F.col("bid_state") == "lost")
    .groupBy("commodity_lot_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("polar_adapter"),
        F.round(F.avg("lot_tonnes"), 2).alias("lost_avg_lot_tonnes"),
    )
)

result = (
    won_by_commodity_lot_ref.alias("a")
    .join(lost_by_commodity_lot_ref.alias("b"), F.col("a.commodity_lot_ref") == F.col("b.commodity_lot_ref"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.commodity_lot_ref"), F.col("b.commodity_lot_ref")).alias("commodity_lot_ref"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.won_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("won_count"),
        F.col("a.won_total_lot_tonnes"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.polar_adapter"), F.lit(0)).alias("polar_adapter"),
        F.col("b.lost_avg_lot_tonnes"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.won_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.polar_adapter"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("commodity_lot_ref")
```

```python
    valid_claims
    .groupBy(F.year("claim_date").alias("claim_date_year"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("approved_amount").alias("total_approved_amount"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),

    )

    .crossJoin(totals.agg(F.min("total_approved_amount").alias("overall_min_total_approved_amount")))
    .filter(F.col("total_approved_amount") > F.col("overall_min_total_approved_amount"))

    )
)

first_rows = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("row_count_dense_rank") <= 5)
    .drop("row_count_dense_rank")
)

windowed = (

    .select(
```

```sql
    FROM scored
),
terminal_code_or_unknown_stats AS (
    -- Avg wait_secs_distance_to_bag_weight_kg_ratio per terminal_code_or_unknown
```

```sql
sessionized AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY course_kind_group ORDER BY served_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no

    )
```

```sql
with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(valve_opened_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY season_tag ORDER BY valve_opened_ts, id) AS prev_valve_opened_ts
    FROM cleaned_irrigation_runs
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_valve_opened_ts IS NULL OR valve_opened_ts > prev_valve_opened_ts + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY season_tag ORDER BY valve_opened_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        season_tag,
        burst_id,
        MIN(valve_opened_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(valve_opened_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(water_litres) AS session_water_litres,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(valve_opened_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(valve_opened_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY season_tag, burst_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE n_events > (SELECT MIN(n_events) FROM sessions)
)
SELECT
    season_tag,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    session_water_litres,
    duration_min,
    COALESCE(burst_id, 0) AS burst_id_filled
FROM without_matches
ORDER BY season_tag
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_irrigation_runs = df_irrigation_runs.filter(F.col("water_litres") <= 12498)

with_prev = cleaned_irrigation_runs.withColumn("prev_valve_opened_ts", F.lag("valve_opened_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy("valve_opened_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_valve_opened_ts").isNull() | (F.col("valve_opened_ts") > F.col("prev_valve_opened_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag").orderBy("valve_opened_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("season_tag", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("valve_opened_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("valve_opened_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("water_litres").alias("session_water_litres"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("valve_opened_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("valve_opened_ts"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    sessions
    .crossJoin(sessions.agg(F.min("n_events").alias("overall_min_n_events")))
    .filter(F.col("n_events") > F.col("overall_min_n_events"))
    .drop("overall_min_n_events")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "season_tag",
        "session_start",
        "n_events",
        "session_water_litres",
        "duration_min",
        F.coalesce(F.col("burst_id"), F.lit(0)).alias("burst_id_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy("season_tag")
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY grade_status, burst_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE event_count > (SELECT AVG(event_count) FROM per_session)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    grade_status,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    session_score_filled,
    duration_min
FROM without_matches
WHERE burst_id >= 2
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("student_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("score"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("score_filled"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | (F.col("enrolled_at") > F.col("prev_enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("grade_status", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("score_filled").alias("session_score_filled"),

    )
)

without_matches = (
    per_session
    .crossJoin(per_session.agg(F.avg("event_count").alias("overall_avg_event_count")))
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > F.col("overall_avg_event_count"))
    .drop("overall_avg_event_count")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .filter(F.col("burst_id") >= 2)
    .select(
        "grade_status",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "event_count",
        "session_score_filled",
        "duration_min",
    )
)
```

```python
    df_onyx_dashboards

        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
    )

w_course_id = Window.partitionBy("course_id")
w_student_id_grade_status_by_s = Window.partitionBy("student_id", "grade_status").orderBy(F.col("score").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (
    prepared
    .select(
        "id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status", F.to_date("enrolled_at")).orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("score_avg_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("score").desc())).alias("score_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status", "term")), 2).alias("grade_status_term_avg_score"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at"))), 2).alias("student_id_enrolled_at_month_avg_score"),

        F.lag("score").over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")).alias("prev_score"),
        F.rank().over(w_student_id_grade_status_by_s).alias("score_rank"),
        F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at"))).alias("toolkit_tally"),
        F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status", "term")).alias("grade_status_term_sum_score"),
        F.max("score").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id")).alias("course_id_max_score"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", F.date_trunc("month", "enrolled_at"))).alias("rows_in_student_id_enrolled_at_month"),
        F.first("enrolled_at").over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_enrolled_at"),
    )
)

stats = (

    .groupBy("rn", "term")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),

        F.percentile_approx("score_rank", 0.5).alias("median_score_rank"),
        F.min("rows_in_student_id_enrolled_at_month").alias("min_rows_in_student_id_enrolled_at_month"),
        F.round(F.avg("grade_status_term_sum_score"), 2).alias("avg_grade_status_term_sum_score"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter((F.col("score") <= 79.2) | (F.month(F.col("enrolled_at")).isin(1, 2)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("enrolled_at")).alias("enrolled_at_week"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    valid
    .groupBy("course_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("grade_status") == "INCOMPLETE", 1)).alias("n_grade_status_incomplete"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("student_id").alias("distinct_student_ids"),

        F.avg("score").alias("avg_score_check"),

    .filter(F.col("avg_score_check") > 10.8)
    .drop("avg_score_check")
)

w_course_id_by_n_grade_status = Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("n_grade_status_incomplete", "course_id")
with_trends = (

    .select(

        F.lead("max_score", 2).over(Window.orderBy("max_score", "course_id")).alias("next2_max_score"),

    )
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_avg_score, 0) AS withdrawn_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    COALESCE(b.pass_avg_score, 0) AS pass_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_student a
FULL OUTER JOIN pass_by_student b
  ON a.student_id = b.student_id
ORDER BY student_id
```

```python
    df_enrollments
```

```sql
with_parent AS (
    -- Attach warehouses_v attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouses_v_no,
        s.pallet_state,
        s.pick_lines,
        s.slot_minutes_per_pick_lines,
        s.pick_lines_per_slot_minutes,
        w.lift_model AS warehouses_v_lift_model
    FROM prepared s
    JOIN warehouses_v w ON w.id = s.warehouses_v_no
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per forklift_log
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouses_v_no,
        s.pallet_state,
        s.pick_lines_per_slot_minutes,
        s.warehouses_v_lift_model,
        f.id AS forklift_log_id,
        f.pallet_state AS forklift_log_pallet_state,
        f.pick_lines AS forklift_log_pick_lines
    FROM with_parent s
    JOIN forklift_logs f ON f.warehouses_v_no = s.warehouses_v_no
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(forklift_log_pick_lines - 40) AS forklift_log_pick_lines_distance,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(warehouses_v_lift_model), ' ', '_')) AS warehouses_v_lift_model_slug,
        COALESCE(forklift_log_pick_lines, 0) AS forklift_log_pick_lines_filled
    FROM exploded_detail
    WHERE warehouses_v_no <= 3
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN forklift_log_pick_lines >= 46 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN forklift_log_pick_lines >= 18 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS forklift_log_pick_lines_tier
    FROM labeled
),
pick_task_stats AS (

    SELECT
        warehouses_v_id,
        COUNT(*) AS pick_task_count,

    FROM pick_tasks

),
summarized_rows AS (

) src
PIVOT (

    FOR forklift_log_pallet_state IN ('staged', 'stored', 'shipped', 'inbound')
)
ORDER BY warehouses_v_lift_model, pick_task_count_2
```

```sql
WITH valid_plays AS (
    -- Scope the plays rows
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        is_skipped,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(device), 1, 2) AS device_prefix,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(device), 1, 2) AS device_prefix_2
    FROM plays
    WHERE ms_played < 287769
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(played_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS played_at_label
    FROM valid_plays
    WHERE listener_id <= 11
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        listener_id,
        YEAR(played_at) AS played_at_year,
        CASE WHEN ms_played >= 223828 THEN 'A' WHEN ms_played >= 129336 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS ms_played_tier,
        ROUND(STDDEV(ms_played), 2) AS stddev_ms_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_skipped = FALSE THEN ms_played ELSE 0 END) AS ms_played_is_skipped_false,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_skipped = FALSE THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_is_skipped_false
    FROM annotated
    WHERE device_prefix IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY listener_id, YEAR(played_at), CASE WHEN ms_played >= 223828 THEN 'A' WHEN ms_played >= 129336 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT listener_id, ms_played_tier, stddev_ms_played
    FROM rollup_base
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(stddev_ms_played)
    FOR ms_played_tier IN ('C', 'B')
)
ORDER BY listener_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("ms_played") < 287769)
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "is_skipped",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("device")), 1, 2).alias("device_prefix"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("device")), 1, 2).alias("device_prefix_2"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    valid_plays
    .filter(F.col("listener_id") <= 11)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format(F.col("played_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("played_at_label"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    annotated
    .filter(F.col("device_prefix").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(
        "listener_id",
        F.year("played_at").alias("played_at_year"),
        F.when(F.col("ms_played") >= 223828, "A").when(F.col("ms_played") >= 129336, "B").otherwise("C").alias("ms_played_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("ms_played"), 2).alias("stddev_ms_played"),
        F.sum(F.when(~F.col("is_skipped"), F.col("ms_played")).otherwise(0)).alias("ms_played_is_skipped_false"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(~F.col("is_skipped"), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_is_skipped_false"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 2)
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .groupBy("listener_id")
    .pivot("ms_played_tier", ["C", "B"])
    .agg(F.min("stddev_ms_played"))
    .orderBy("listener_id")
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,

        status_code,
        terrace_ts,

with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER w_recent AS latency_ms_rank
    FROM exploded
    WHERE status_code <= 434
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY level, host ORDER BY latency_ms NULLS LAST)
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', host, level) AS host_level_key,
        FLOOR(status_code) AS status_code_whole,
        COALESCE(terrace_ts, 'NONE') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE terrace_ts IS NOT NULL
),
valid_app_logs AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        status_code + status_code_whole AS status_code_plus_status_code_whole,
        FLOOR(latency_ms) AS latency_ms_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE terrace_ts IS DISTINCT FROM 'version'

),
scored AS (

        CORR(latency_ms, status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service, host) AS corr_latency_ms_status_code,
        MAX(status_code_whole) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS stadium_flag,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_whole DESC) AS status_code_whole_cume_dist
    FROM valid_app_logs
)

    MAX(latency_ms_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts), host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS latency_ms_whole_max_2h
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("level", "host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

exploded = (
    df_azure_submarines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("terrace_ts", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("status_code") <= 434)
    .select("*", F.rank().over(w_recent).alias("latency_ms_rank"))
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("terrace_ts").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("host_level_key", F.concat_ws("-", "host", "level"))
    .withColumn("status_code_whole", F.floor("status_code"))
    .withColumn("attr_key_clean", F.coalesce("terrace_ts", F.lit("NONE")))
)

valid_app_logs = (
    valid
    .filter((~F.col("terrace_ts").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version"))) & F.col("terrace_ts").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("status_code_plus_status_code_whole", (F.col("status_code") + F.col("status_code_whole")))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_whole", F.floor("latency_ms"))
)

scored = (
    valid_app_logs
    .withColumn("status_code_plus_status_code_whole_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("terrace_ts").orderBy(F.col("status_code_plus_status_code_whole").asc_nulls_first())))
    .withColumn("corr_latency_ms_status_code", F.corr("latency_ms", "status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("service", "host")))
    .withColumn("stadium_flag", F.max("status_code_whole").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("status_code_whole_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code_whole").desc())))
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_value",
        "latency_ms_rank",
        "host_level_key",
        "status_code_plus_status_code_whole",
        "latency_ms_whole",
        "status_code_plus_status_code_whole_cume_dist",
        "stadium_flag",
        "status_code_whole_cume_dist",
        F.avg("stadium_flag").over(w_running).alias("status_code_whole_max_30m_avg_15m"),
        F.max("latency_ms_whole").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)).alias("latency_ms_whole_max_2h"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.registered_on_month, b.registered_on_month) AS registered_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.legend_count, 0) AS legend_count,
    a.legend_avg_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS rare_count,
    b.rare_total_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(a.legend_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS legend_count_minus_rare_count
FROM legend_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN rare_monthly b
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("site_id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
        F.hour(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_hour"),
    )
)

w_read_at_to_date_quality = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality")
w_all_by_read_at_ties = Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first())
with_windows = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("read_at_seq"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("site_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality"))).alias("distinct_site_id_in_read_at_to_date_quality"),
        F.first("read_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_read_at"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh") - F.avg("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality")), 2).alias("kwh_vs_read_at_to_date_quality_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)), 2).alias("voltage_avg_1_prior"),
        F.max("read_at_hour").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_read_at_hour_so_far"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage") - F.avg("voltage").over(w_read_at_to_date_quality), 2).alias("voltage_vs_read_at_to_date_quality_avg"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("read_at_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality")), 2).alias("read_at_to_date_quality_avg_kwh"),
        F.sum("read_at_hour").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality")).alias("read_at_to_date_quality_sum_read_at_hour"),
        F.first("kwh", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_kwh"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_read_at_ties), 3).alias("read_at_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("read_at"), "quality")).alias("read_at_to_date_quality_sum_voltage"),
        F.last("read_at_hour").over(Window.orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_read_at_hour"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("kwh") / F.nullif(F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_seq")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("kwh_share_of_read_at_seq"),
        F.round(F.col("max_read_at_hour_so_far") / F.nullif(F.sum("max_read_at_hour_so_far").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_seq")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("max_read_at_hour_so_far_share_of_read_at_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("read_at_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("distinct_site_id_in_read_at_to_date_quality", "read_at_dense_rank").orderBy(F.col("kwh_vs_read_at_to_date_quality_avg").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("read_at_seq_avg_2"),
        F.min("last_read_at_hour").over(Window.orderBy("voltage_avg_1_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_last_read_at_hour_so_far"),
        F.max("read_at_percent_rank").over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("first_known_read_at"))).alias("first_known_read_at_to_date_max_read_at_percent_"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("first_known_read_at"))).alias("rows_in_first_known_read_at_to_date"),
        F.min("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("read_at_seq")).alias("read_at_seq_min_voltage"),
    )
)

result = (
    windowed
    .filter(F.col("rows_in_first_known_read_at_to_date") >= 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality_ref",
        "read_at_hour",
        "read_at_seq",
        "distinct_site_id_in_read_at_to_date_quality",
        "kwh_vs_read_at_to_date_quality_avg",
        "max_read_at_hour_so_far",
        "read_at_dense_rank",
        "read_at_to_date_quality_avg_kwh",
        "first_known_kwh",
        "running_count",
        "read_at_percent_rank",
        "read_at_to_date_quality_sum_voltage",
        "last_read_at_hour",
        "max_read_at_hour_so_far_share_of_read_at_seq",
        "read_at_seq_avg_2",
        "min_last_read_at_hour_so_far",
        "first_known_read_at_to_date_max_read_at_percent_",
        "rows_in_first_known_read_at_to_date",
        F.date_format(F.col("first_known_read_at"), "yyyy-MM").alias("first_known_read_at_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("read_at_seq_avg_2").asc())
)
```

```sql
    FROM filtered_events

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev

    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        actor,
        session_no,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, session_no
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        actor,
        session_no,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        duration_min,
        COALESCE(actor, 'UNKNOWN') AS actor_or_unknown,
        DAYOFWEEK(session_start) AS session_start_dayofweek,
        CASE WHEN actor IN ('agent', 'customer') THEN 'group_a' WHEN actor = 'system' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS actor_group
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE actor = 'system'
)

    actor_group,
    session_no,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(actor)) AS actor_list,

FROM labeled
```

```python
    )
)

valid = (
    lines
    .filter(~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version")))
    .select("*", F.initcap(F.trim("attr_key")).alias("attr_key_title"))
)

        F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "region", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_region"),
    )
)
```

```sql
screened AS (

    FROM screened
    GROUP BY site_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h - g.median_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS prior_rows_12h_minus_median
    FROM screened s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h >= g.median_prior_rows_12h
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    prior_rows_12h,
    prior_voltage_12h,
    prior_rows_12h_minus_median,

FROM compared
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
```

```sql
with_activity AS (

    FROM without_matches s
    WHERE s.eatery_no IN (

            FROM menu_dishes m
        )
)
SELECT *

    SELECT cuisine_type_len, spice_lvl, spice_lvl_tier, line_qty
    FROM with_activity
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_menu_dishes
    .filter(F.col("line_qty") > 3)
    .select(
```

```sql
    FROM recent

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_offer_made_ts IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(offer_made_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_offer_made_ts)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY valley_tower ORDER BY offer_made_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY valley_tower, session_id
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE session_asking_price < (SELECT MAX(session_asking_price) FROM sessions)
),
totals AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        session_id,
        valley_tower,
        events,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valley_tower = 'townhome' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS duration_min_property_type_townhome,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(valley_tower)) AS property_type_list
    FROM qualified
    GROUP BY session_id, valley_tower, events
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    session_id,
    valley_tower,
    events,
    duration_min_property_type_townhome,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_steamers
    .select(
        "id",
        "valley_tower",
        "offer_status",
        "floor_sqm",
        "asking_price",
        "offer_made_ts",
        "flag_has_parking",
        F.concat(F.col("offer_status"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("daily_bakerie"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent.withColumn("prev_offer_made_ts", F.lag("offer_made_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("valley_tower").orderBy("offer_made_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_offer_made_ts").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("offer_made_ts") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_offer_made_ts")) / 60 > 60), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("valley_tower").orderBy("offer_made_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("valley_tower", "session_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("offer_made_ts").alias("session_end"),

    sessions
    .crossJoin(sessions.agg(F.max("session_asking_price").alias("overall_max_session_asking_price")))
    .filter(F.col("session_asking_price") < F.col("overall_max_session_asking_price"))
    .drop("overall_max_session_asking_price")
)

totals = (
    qualified
    .groupBy("session_id", "valley_tower", "events")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("valley_tower") == "townhome", F.col("duration_min")).otherwise(0)).alias("duration_min_property_type_townhome"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("valley_tower")).alias("property_type_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "session_id",
        "valley_tower",
        "events",
        "duration_min_property_type_townhome",
        "property_type_list",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("valley_tower"))).alias("property_type_clean"),
        F.when(F.col("events") >= 4, "HIGH").when(F.col("events") >= 2, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("events_tier"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
enriched_listener AS (
    -- Join listeners
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        l.birth_year AS listener_birth_year
    FROM covered s
    JOIN listeners l ON l.id = s.listener_id
    WHERE l.birth_year > 1966
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching plays
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched_listener s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM plays p
            WHERE p.listener_id = s.listener_id
              AND p.is_skipped = TRUE
              AND p.source IN ('search', 'radio', 'album')
        )
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        prior_rows_12h,
        TO_DATE(played_at) AS played_at_day,
        listener_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listener_id) AS distinct_listener_ids,
        MIN(played_at) AS first_played_at
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE prior_rows_12h < 6
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    prior_rows_12h,
    played_at_day,
    listener_id,
    distinct_listener_ids,
    first_played_at,
    LEAST(distinct_listener_ids, prior_rows_12h) AS least_distinct_listener_ids_prior_rows_12h
FROM rollup_base
WHERE listener_id >= 16
ORDER BY played_at_day, distinct_listener_ids
```

```sql
        id,
        listener_id,
        ms_played,
        device,
        source_len,
        least_ms_played_source_len,
        ms_played_filled,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(listener_id) OVER (PARTITION BY device, track_id)) AS distinct_listener_id_in_device_track_id,
        MAX(ms_played_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY device, track_id) AS device_track_id_max_ms_played_filled,
        MAX(source_len) OVER (PARTITION BY device, track_id) AS device_track_id_max_source_len
    FROM derived
),
enriched AS (
```

```sql
    where s.rating >= 3.0
),
with_latest as (

        s.brand,
        s.price,
        s.supplier_id,
        s.city,
        s.rating,

    left join lateral (

    (select sum(p2.price) from stg_galleries p2 where p2.supplier_id = s.supplier_id) as sum_product_price
from with_latest s
order by id, sum_product_price
limit 20;
```

```python
w_artist_id_release_date_year = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy("release_date", "id")
windowed = (
    valid_tracks
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        "moods",
        "release_date_label",
        F.first("release_date").over(Window.orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_release_date"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit")).alias("artist_id_is_explicit_max_duration_sec"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("duration_sec_max_1_prior"),
        (F.col("duration_sec") - F.lag("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id"))).alias("duration_sec_change"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "artist_id").orderBy(F.col("release_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_duration_sec_so_far"),
        F.min("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id_release_date_month).alias("artist_id_release_date_month_min_duration_sec"),
        (F.col("duration_sec") - F.lag("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id_release_date_year)).alias("duration_sec_change_2"),
        F.first("release_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_release_date"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit")).alias("artist_id_is_explicit_sum_duration_sec"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_quartile"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("duration_sec_sum_1_prior"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "artist_id")), 2).alias("is_explicit_artist_id_avg_duration_sec"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_quintile"),
    )
)

derived = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        "is_explicit",
        "moods",
        "release_date_label",
        "first_release_date",
        "duration_sec_max_1_prior",
        "duration_sec_change",
        "max_duration_sec_so_far",
        "duration_sec_change_2",
        "duration_sec_sum_1_prior",
        "is_explicit_artist_id_avg_duration_sec",
        "duration_sec_quintile",
        (F.col("duration_sec_max_1_prior") + F.col("duration_sec_change")).alias("duration_sec_max_1_prior_plus_duration_sec_chang"),

)

    .filter(F.col("duration_sec_max_1_prior_plus_duration_sec_chang") > 0)

        "n_is_explicit_false",
        F.max("n_is_explicit_false").over(Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_tier")).alias("duration_sec_tier_max_n_is_explicit_false"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("n_rows", "first_release_date_year", "duration_sec_tier")).alias("n_rows_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "first_release_date_year",
        "duration_sec_tier",
        "avg_duration_sec_quintile",
        "n_is_explicit_false",
        "duration_sec_tier_max_n_is_explicit_false",
        "n_rows_dense_rank",
        F.coalesce(F.col("n_rows_dense_rank"), F.lit(0)).alias("n_rows_dense_rank_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        "n_is_explicit_false",
        F.col("first_release_date_year").desc_nulls_first(),
    )
)
```

```sql
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection

    agent_id,

    session_end,
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        actor,
        session_no,
        MIN(event_at) AS coastal_creamerie,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS alpha_codice
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    actor,
    session_no,
    coastal_creamerie,
    events,
    alpha_codice,
    COALESCE(session_no, 0) AS session_no_filled,
    GREATEST(session_no, events) AS greatest_session_no_events
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_no DESC, session_no_filled
```

```python
    )
```

```sql
    -- Scope the tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        channel,
        tags
    FROM tickets
    WHERE requester_id > 4
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach ticket_events metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.event_at) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.id) AS first_event_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.id) AS event_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.event_type <> 'created') FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.id) AS event_event_type_count
    FROM recent s
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows that have matching tickets
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_stats s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tickets t
            WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id
              AND t.priority = 'P3'
        )
),
combined_details_agent AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.channel,
        s.tags,
        s.first_event_at,
        s.event_count,
        s.event_event_type_count,
        su.tier AS agent_tier,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on,
        su.team AS agent_team
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(event_count, event_event_type_count) AS least_event_count_event_event_type_count,
        SIZE(tags) AS tags_count,
        LENGTH(TRIM(agent_team)) AS agent_team_len
    FROM combined_details_agent
    WHERE opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-06 06:00:00'
)
SELECT DISTINCT event_event_type_count, agent_team_len, requester_id
FROM enriched
WHERE agent_team <> 'VIP'
ORDER BY requester_id, event_event_type_count DESC
```

```sql
summary AS (
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
```

```sql
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(data_mb, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS data_mb_quartiles,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(data_mb, 0.9) AS data_mb_p90
    FROM reconciled

SELECT
    data_mb_tier,
    data_mb_stddev,
    data_mb_quartiles,
```

```python
valid = (
    df_stg_boulders
    .filter((~F.col("plan_tier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("prepaid"))) & F.col("plan_tier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "tower_vendor",
        "data_mb",
        "msisdn_mask",
        F.upper("plan_tier").alias("plan_tier_upper"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("tower_vendor").orderBy(F.col("data_mb").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "data_mb", "msisdn_mask")
)

filtered = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("data_mb") >= 2400)
    .withColumn("msisdn_mask_title", F.initcap(F.trim("msisdn_mask")))

matched_keys = (

reconciled = (
```

```sql
    FROM loss_notices

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY cover_contract_id ORDER BY filed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        cover_contract_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(filed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(filed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(premium_amt_adj) AS session_premium_amt_adj,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(filed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(filed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY cover_contract_id, burst_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        event_count,
        cover_contract_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min,
        MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,
        ROUND(STDDEV(event_count), 2) AS stddev_event_count,
        ROUND(AVG(session_premium_amt_adj), 2) AS avg_session_premium_amt_adj,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cover_contract_id) AS distinct_cover_contract_ids
    FROM sessions
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    distinct_cover_contract_ids,
    event_count,
    SUM(median_duration_min) AS total_median_duration_min,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    MIN(first_session_start) AS first_first_session_start
FROM summary
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.on_loan_avg_created_year, 0) AS on_loan_avg_created_year,
    COALESCE(a.owned_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.on_loan_count, 0) AS owned_count_minus_on_loan_count
```

```python
joined_athlete = (
```

```sql
        CONCAT_WS('-', term, grade_status) AS term_grade_status_label,

    FROM enrollments

),
derived AS (

    SELECT

        course_id,

annotated AS (

        CASE WHEN score_filled_2 >= 55.0 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN score_filled_2 >= 30.0 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS score_filled_2_tier
    FROM derived
),

compared AS (
```

```python
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped")).alias("rows_in_is_skipped"),
```

```sql
WITH approved_by_bank_branche_ref AS (
    -- approved rows per bank_branche_ref
    SELECT bank_branche_ref, COUNT(*) AS approved_count, SUM(credit_band) AS approved_total_credit_band
    FROM atm_units
    WHERE app_status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY bank_branche_ref
),
submitted_by_bank_branche_ref AS (
    -- submitted rows per bank_branche_ref
    SELECT bank_branche_ref, COUNT(*) AS submitted_count, ROUND(AVG(credit_band), 2) AS submitted_avg_credit_band
    FROM atm_units
    WHERE app_status = 'submitted'
    GROUP BY bank_branche_ref
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.bank_branche_ref, b.bank_branche_ref) AS bank_branche_ref,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) AS approved_count,
    a.approved_total_credit_band,
    COALESCE(b.submitted_count, 0) AS submitted_count,
    b.submitted_avg_credit_band,
    COALESCE(a.approved_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.submitted_count, 0) AS approved_count_minus_submitted_count
FROM approved_by_bank_branche_ref a
FULL OUTER JOIN submitted_by_bank_branche_ref b
  ON a.bank_branche_ref = b.bank_branche_ref
ORDER BY bank_branche_ref
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

approved_by_bank_branche_ref = (
    df_atm_units
    .filter(F.col("app_status") == "approved")
    .groupBy("bank_branche_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("approved_count"),
        F.sum("credit_band").alias("approved_total_credit_band"),
    )
)

submitted_by_bank_branche_ref = (
    df_atm_units
    .filter(F.col("app_status") == "submitted")
    .groupBy("bank_branche_ref")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("submitted_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("credit_band"), 2).alias("submitted_avg_credit_band"),
    )
)

result = (
    approved_by_bank_branche_ref.alias("a")
    .join(submitted_by_bank_branche_ref.alias("b"), F.col("a.bank_branche_ref") == F.col("b.bank_branche_ref"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.bank_branche_ref"), F.col("b.bank_branche_ref")).alias("bank_branche_ref"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("approved_count"),
        F.col("a.approved_total_credit_band"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.submitted_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("submitted_count"),
        F.col("b.submitted_avg_credit_band"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.approved_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.submitted_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("approved_count_minus_submitted_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("bank_branche_ref")
)
```

```sql
        s.*,
        COALESCE(p.policy_count, 0) AS policy_count,
        COALESCE(p.policy_status_count, 0) AS policy_status_count
    FROM with_details s
    LEFT JOIN policy_stats p ON p.holder_id = s.holder_id
)
SELECT

    status,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM with_stats
GROUP BY CUBE(holder_id, status)
ORDER BY holder_id NULLS LAST, status NULLS LAST
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_policies
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "premium",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.coalesce(F.col("premium"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("premium_filled"),

        "p.holder_name",

policy_stats = (
```

```python
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),

    )
)

    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("first_reading_read_at"),
        F.min("read_at").alias("first_reading_read_at_2"),
    )

    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "m.first_reading_read_at", "m.first_reading_read_at_2")
```

```python
    .withColumn("first_known_vcpu_cnt", F.first("vcpu_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "provisioned_on"), "page_sev").orderBy("cost_per_hr", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
```

```sql
screened AS (
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
```

```sql
        *,
```

```sql
        UPPER(city) city_upper,
        COALESCE(city, 'NONE') city_filled
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *

    SELECT
        country,
        city,
        last3_sum_rating
    FROM valid
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(last3_sum_rating) AS amount,
    COUNT(1) AS item_count
    FOR city IN ('Singapore' AS singapore, 'New York' AS new_york)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("supplier_name_country", F.concat("supplier_name", F.lit(", "), "country"))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_min_rating"),
        F.max("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_max_rating"),
        F.avg("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_avg_rating"),
        F.sum("rating").over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_sum_rating"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.lower("supplier_name").like("%ion%"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("last3_avg_rating", 1).alias("last3_avg_rating_rounded"),
        F.upper("city").alias("city_upper"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("NONE")).alias("city_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy("country")
    .pivot("city", ["Singapore", "New York"])
    .agg(

        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("item_count"),

        F.col("Singapore_item_count").alias("singapore_item_count"),
        F.col("New York_amount").alias("new_york_amount"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_voyages = (
    df_western_ceramics
    .filter(F.col("reefer_temp") >= -20.1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "vessel_id",
        "circuit_ts",
        "built_on",
        "is_reefer",
        F.date_format(F.col("built_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("built_on_label"),
        F.when(F.col("is_reefer"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_reefer_label"),
    )
)

w_is_reefer_label_vessel_id = Window.partitionBy("is_reefer_label", "vessel_id")
with_windows = (
    filtered_voyages
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("circuit_ts") / F.nullif(F.sum("circuit_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer_label", "vessel_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("gross_tonnage_share_of_is_reefer_label_vessel_id"),
        F.first("built_on", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("vessel_id", "is_reefer").orderBy("circuit_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_built_on"),
        (F.col("circuit_ts") - F.lag("circuit_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("built_on").desc(), "id"))).alias("gross_tonnage_change"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer_label", "vessel_id")).alias("rows_in_is_reefer_label_vessel_id"),
        F.first("circuit_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer_label").orderBy("circuit_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_gross_tonnage"),
        F.round(F.col("circuit_ts") - F.avg("circuit_ts").over(w_is_reefer_label_vessel_id), 2).alias("gross_tonnage_vs_is_reefer_label_vessel_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.avg("circuit_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("built_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("gross_tonnage_avg_4"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer_label").orderBy("circuit_ts", "id")).alias("granite_diorama"),
    )
)

top_per_group = (
    with_windows
    .filter((F.col("granite_diorama") <= 2) & (F.col("circuit_ts") < 205103))
    .drop("granite_diorama")
)

stats = (
    top_per_group
    .groupBy(
        "is_reefer",
        F.date_format("built_on", "yyyy-MM").alias("built_on_ym"),
        "vessel_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("vessel_id").alias("distinct_vessel_ids"),
        F.max("built_on").alias("last_built_on"),
    )
)

w_is_reefer_by_last_built_on = Window.partitionBy("is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("last_built_on").desc(), "is_reefer", "built_on_ym", "vessel_id")
metrics = (

        "built_on_ym",
        "vessel_id",
        "distinct_vessel_ids",
        "last_built_on",
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_is_reefer_by_last_built_on), 3).alias("last_built_on_percent_rank"),

    )
)

        "vessel_id",

        "is_reefer",
        "built_on_ym",
```

```sql
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS read_at_month, COUNT(*) AS ok_count, SUM(kwh) AS ok_total_kwh
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'OK'

bad_monthly AS (
    -- BAD rows per read_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS read_at_month, COUNT(*) AS bad_count, SUM(kwh) AS bad_total_kwh
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality = 'BAD'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.read_at_month, b.read_at_month) AS read_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) AS ok_count,
    a.ok_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    COALESCE(b.bad_total_kwh, 0) AS bad_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM ok_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_monthly b
  ON a.read_at_month = b.read_at_month
ORDER BY read_at_month
```

```python
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "OK")

    .agg(F.count("*").alias("ok_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("ok_total_kwh"))
)

bad_monthly = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "BAD")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at").alias("read_at_month"))
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("bad_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("bad_total_kwh"))
)

result = (
```
