    .join(bad_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.read_at_month") == F.col("b.read_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.read_at_month"), F.col("b.read_at_month")).alias("read_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ok_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_count"),
        F.col("a.ok_total_kwh"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_total_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_total_kwh"),

        tap_media,
        stop_label,
        rider_cnt,
        visited_at,
        kiosk_owner,
        is_accessible,

    FROM depots

),
with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(visited_at) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY visited_at, id) AS prev_visited_at
    FROM valid_depots
),
flagged AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_visited_at IS NULL OR visited_at > prev_visited_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY visited_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        stop_label,
        session_id,
        MIN(visited_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(visited_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(rider_cnt) AS session_rider_cnt,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(visited_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(visited_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY stop_label, session_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE session_id > (SELECT MIN(session_id) FROM sessions)
)
SELECT
    stop_label,
    session_id,
    event_count,
    SUM(session_rider_cnt) AS total_session_rider_cnt,
    ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN stop_label = 'Pier' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_stop_label_pier,
    ROUND(SUM(duration_min), 2) AS total_duration_min
FROM screened
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((stop_label, session_id, event_count), (stop_label), ())
ORDER BY stop_label NULLS LAST, session_id NULLS LAST, event_count NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_depots = (
    df_depots
    .filter(F.col("tap_media") == "cash")
    .select(
        "id",
        "tap_media",
        "stop_label",
        "rider_cnt",
        "visited_at",
        "kiosk_owner",
        "is_accessible",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("visited_at")).alias("days_since_visited_at"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid_depots.withColumn("prev_visited_at", F.lag("visited_at").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("visited_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_visited_at").isNull() | (F.col("visited_at") > F.col("prev_visited_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        F.round(F.sum("duration_min"), 2).alias("total_duration_min"),

WITH covered AS (
    -- Claims that fall inside the policy coverage period
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.policy_id,
        c.claim_date,
        c.claimed_amount,
        c.claim_type,
        c.approved_amount,
        p.product,
        p.premium
    FROM claims c
    LEFT JOIN policies p
      ON p.id = c.policy_id
     AND c.claim_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND COALESCE(p.end_date, DATE '2099-12-31')
),
product_stats AS (
    -- Max claimed_amount per product
    SELECT product, MAX(claimed_amount) AS max_claimed_amount
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY product
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(s.claimed_amount - g.max_claimed_amount, 2) AS claimed_amount_minus_max
    FROM covered s
    JOIN product_stats g ON g.product = s.product
    WHERE s.claimed_amount = g.max_claimed_amount
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching claims
    SELECT s.*
    FROM outliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM claims c
            WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id
              AND c.adjuster_id >= 3
        )
      AND s.claimed_amount_minus_max <= 25000.0
)
SELECT
    id,
    policy_id,
    claim_date,
    claim_type,
    approved_amount,
    product,
    premium,
    max_claimed_amount
FROM qualified
ORDER BY claim_date DESC, policy_id DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

covered = (
    df_claims.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_policies.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.id") == F.col("c.policy_id"))
        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "c.id",
        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",
        "c.claimed_amount",
        "c.claim_type",
        "c.approved_amount",
        "p.product",
        "p.premium",
    )
)

product_stats = (
    covered
    .groupBy("product")
    .agg(F.max("claimed_amount").alias("max_claimed_amount"))
)

outliers = (
    covered.alias("s")
    .join(product_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.product") == F.col("s.product"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.claimed_amount") == F.col("g.max_claimed_amount"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_claimed_amount",
        F.round(F.col("s.claimed_amount") - F.col("g.max_claimed_amount"), 2).alias("claimed_amount_minus_max"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(df_claims.alias("c"), (F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id")) & (F.col("c.adjuster_id") >= 3), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("claimed_amount_minus_max") <= 25000.0)
)

result = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "approved_amount",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "max_claimed_amount",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("claim_date").desc(), F.col("policy_id").desc())
)

WITH withdrawn_by_student AS (
    -- WITHDRAWN rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS withdrawn_avg_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
    GROUP BY student_id
),
pass_by_student AS (
    -- PASS rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS pass_count, SUM(score) AS pass_total_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'PASS'
    GROUP BY student_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.student_id, b.student_id) AS student_id,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    a.withdrawn_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    COALESCE(b.pass_total_score, 0) AS pass_total_score,
    COALESCE(a.withdrawn_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pass_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM withdrawn_by_student a
FULL OUTER JOIN pass_by_student b
  ON a.student_id = b.student_id
ORDER BY student_id
```

    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "WITHDRAWN")

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("score"), 2).alias("withdrawn_avg_score"),
    )
)

pass_by_student = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "PASS")
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("pass_count"),

        "holder_id",
        "premium",
        "start_date",
        "status",
        F.date_format(F.col("start_date"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("start_date_label"),
        F.round(F.col("premium") * 1.1, 2).alias("premium_adj"),
    )
)

combined_details_holder = (
    filtered_policys.alias("s")
    .join(df_policyholders.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.holder_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.joined_on") < F.lit("2025-04-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("p.joined_on").alias("holder_joined_on"),
        F.col("p.segment").alias("holder_segment"),
    )
)

w_holder_id_by_holder_joined_o = Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy(F.col("holder_joined_on").asc_nulls_last())
w_holder_segment_by_start_date = Window.partitionBy("holder_segment").orderBy("start_date", "id")
w_status = Window.partitionBy("status")
w_holder_segment = Window.partitionBy("holder_segment")
metrics = (

        F.round(F.col("premium") / F.nullif(F.sum("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("status")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("premium_share_of_status"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_holder_id_by_holder_joined_o).alias("holder_joined_on_dense_rank"),
        (F.col("premium_adj") - F.lag("premium_adj").over(w_holder_segment_by_start_date)).alias("premium_adj_change"),

        id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_type,
        status,
        reported_at,
        claim_date_quarter,
        MAX(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_type) AS claim_type_max_approved_amount,
        LEAD(policy_start_date) OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id) AS next_policy_start_date,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_claim_date_quarter_by_claim, 3) AS claim_date_percent_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(approved_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_type ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_approved_amount,
        LAST_VALUE(claimed_amount) OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(claim_date_quarter - AVG(claim_date_quarter) OVER w_claim_date_quarter, 2) AS claim_date_quarter_vs_claim_date_quarter_avg,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_date_quarter ORDER BY claim_date ASC, id) AS claim_date_seq,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_claim_date_quarter AS rows_in_claim_date_quarter,
        ROUND(AVG(claim_date_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY claim_type ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS claim_date_quarter_avg_2_prior,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(policy_id) OVER w_claim_date_quarter) AS distinct_policy_id_in_claim_date_quarter,
        MAX(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY claim_date_quarter DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS approved_amount_max_4
    FROM with_parent

tagged AS (

    df_fixtures
    .filter((F.col("fixture_result").isin("W", "D")) & (F.col("is_home")))

        "position_code",
        "fixture_result",
        "fixture_day",
        "is_home",
        "injury_codes",
    )
)

w_is_home_by_fixture_day = Window.partitionBy("is_home").orderBy(F.col("fixture_day").desc(), "id")
metrics = (

    .select(

    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count_minus_inbound_count

)

    COALESCE(a.misplaced_count, 0) AS misplaced_count,

    COALESCE(b.gap_count, 0) AS gap_count,
    b.gap_avg_promo_lift_percent,
    COALESCE(a.misplaced_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.gap_count, 0) AS misplaced_count_minus_gap_count

    -- Scope the gates rows
    SELECT
        id,
        terminal_id,
        bag_state,
        opened_on,
        service_codes,
        DATE_FORMAT(opened_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS opened_on_label
    FROM gates
    WHERE terminal_id <= 7
      AND bag_state IN ('delayed', 'claimed')
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        terminal_id,
        bag_state,
        opened_on,
        NTH_VALUE(opened_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state ORDER BY opened_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_opened_on,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state, terminal_id ORDER BY opened_on, id) AS seq_no,
        DATEDIFF(opened_on, LAG(opened_on) OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state ORDER BY opened_on DESC, id)) AS days_since_prev_opened_on,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state, terminal_id ORDER BY opened_on), 3) AS opened_on_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER w_terminal_id_by_opened_on_tie, 3) AS opened_on_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state ORDER BY opened_on DESC) AS opened_on_rank,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY opened_on), 3) AS opened_on_percent_rank_4,
        LAG(opened_on) OVER w_bag_state_terminal_id_by_ope AS prev_opened_on,
        LEAD(opened_on) OVER w_bag_state_terminal_id_by_ope AS next_opened_on,
        FIRST_VALUE(opened_on) OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state ORDER BY opened_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_opened_on,
        DATEDIFF(opened_on, LAG(opened_on) OVER w_terminal_id_by_opened_on) AS days_since_prev_opened_on_2
    FROM scoped_gates
    WINDOW w_terminal_id_by_opened_on_tie AS (PARTITION BY terminal_id ORDER BY opened_on ASC), w_bag_state_terminal_id_by_ope AS (PARTITION BY bag_state, terminal_id ORDER BY opened_on, id), w_terminal_id_by_opened_on AS (PARTITION BY terminal_id ORDER BY opened_on ASC, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        terminal_id,
        bag_state,
        second_opened_on,
        days_since_prev_opened_on,
        opened_on_percent_rank,
        opened_on_cume_dist,
        opened_on_rank,
        opened_on_percent_rank_4,
        first_opened_on,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY opened_on_percent_rank_4 NULLS LAST, id), 3) AS opened_on_percent_rank_4_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY seq_no DESC NULLS FIRST), 3) AS seq_no_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bag_state) AS rows_in_bag_state
    FROM ranked
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    terminal_id,
    bag_state,
    second_opened_on,
    days_since_prev_opened_on,
    opened_on_percent_rank,
    opened_on_cume_dist,
    opened_on_rank,
    first_opened_on,
    opened_on_percent_rank_4_cume_dist,
    rows_in_bag_state,
    CASE WHEN opened_on_percent_rank >= 0.8 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN opened_on_percent_rank >= 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS opened_on_percent_rank_tier
FROM metrics
ORDER BY opened_on_percent_rank_4_cume_dist DESC

    FROM tickets

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY requester_id_tier ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY requester_id_tier ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        requester_id_tier,
        session_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY requester_id_tier, session_id
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(requester_id_tier), 1, 2) AS requester_id_tier_prefix,

    FROM per_session

ranked AS (

        LAG(session_end_hour) OVER (ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, requester_id_tier, session_id) AS prev_session_end_hour

WITH rare_monthly AS (
    -- rare rows per registered_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on) AS registered_on_month, COUNT(*) AS rare_count, SUM(ping_ms) AS rare_total_ping_ms
    FROM match_rounds
    WHERE drop_tier = 'rare'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on)
),
common_monthly AS (
    -- common rows per registered_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on) AS registered_on_month, COUNT(*) AS common_count, SUM(ping_ms) AS common_total_ping_ms
    FROM match_rounds
    WHERE drop_tier = 'common'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.registered_on_month, b.registered_on_month) AS registered_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.rare_count, 0) AS rare_count,
    COALESCE(a.rare_total_ping_ms, 0) AS rare_total_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(b.common_count, 0) AS common_count,
    b.common_total_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(a.rare_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.common_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM rare_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN common_monthly b
  ON a.registered_on_month = b.registered_on_month
ORDER BY registered_on_month
```

rare_monthly = (
    df_match_rounds
    .filter(F.col("drop_tier") == "rare")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "registered_on").alias("registered_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rare_count"),
        F.sum("ping_ms").alias("rare_total_ping_ms"),
    )
)

common_monthly = (
    df_match_rounds
    .filter(F.col("drop_tier") == "common")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "registered_on").alias("registered_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("common_count"),
        F.sum("ping_ms").alias("common_total_ping_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    rare_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(common_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.registered_on_month") == F.col("b.registered_on_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.registered_on_month"), F.col("b.registered_on_month")).alias("registered_on_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.rare_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("rare_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.rare_total_ping_ms"), F.lit(0)).alias("rare_total_ping_ms"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.common_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("common_count"),
        F.col("b.common_total_ping_ms"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.rare_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.common_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )

ranked AS (

        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg DESC, id) AS duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg_tercile,
        MAX(first_duration_sec) OVER w_release_date_month AS release_date_month_max_first_duration_sec,
        ROUND(indigo_girder / NULLIF(SUM(indigo_girder) OVER w_release_date_month, 0), 4) AS artist_id_max_bpm_share_of_release_date_month
    FROM windowed
    WINDOW w_release_date_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', release_date))
)
SELECT

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_tracks = (
    df_thermostats
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") < 409)
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
        F.date_format(F.col("release_date"), "MMM yyyy").alias("release_date_label"),
    )
)

w_artist_id = Window.partitionBy("artist_id")
w_artist_id_release_date_year = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())
w_artist_id_by_bpm = Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id")
windowed = (
    prepared_tracks
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("indigo_girder"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") / F.nullif(F.sum("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("duration_sec_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_artist_id_release_date_year), 3).alias("duration_sec_percent_rank"),
        F.nth_value("bpm", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_bpm"),
        F.round(F.col("bpm") / F.nullif(F.sum("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("bpm_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") - F.avg("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id), 2).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("rows_in_artist_id"),
        F.first("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_duration_sec"),
        F.lag("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec"),
        F.min("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("artist_id_min_bpm"),
        F.lead("bpm").over(w_artist_id_by_bpm).alias("next_bpm"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())).alias("duration_sec_dense_rank"),
    )
)

w_release_date_month = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "release_date"))
ranked = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg").desc(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg_tercile"),
        F.max("first_duration_sec").over(w_release_date_month).alias("release_date_month_max_first_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.col("indigo_girder") / F.nullif(F.sum("indigo_girder").over(w_release_date_month), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("artist_id_max_bpm_share_of_release_date_month"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
        "release_date_label",

        "duration_sec_share_of_artist_id",

        "bpm_share_of_artist_id",
        "rows_in_artist_id",

        F.last("carrier", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_carrier"),

    )

    FROM totals

    FROM windowed

    SELECT second_level, next_min_level, team_group, min_level_vs_max_level_avg

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_adjusters = (
    df_adjusters
    .filter(F.col("team").isin("Health", "Property", "Motor"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "adjuster_name",
        "team",
        "level",
        F.when(F.col("team").isin("Health", "Travel"), "group_a").when(F.col("team") == "Motor", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("team_group"),
    )
)

totals = (
    base_adjusters
    .groupBy("team_group", "level")
    .agg(F.min("level").alias("min_level"), F.max("level").alias("max_level"))
)

windowed = (
    totals
    .select(
        "team_group",
        "level",
        "min_level",
        "max_level",
        F.nth_value("level", 2).over(Window.orderBy("min_level", "team_group", "level").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_level"),
        F.sum("level").over(Window.partitionBy("max_level")).alias("max_level_sum_level"),
        F.lead("min_level").over(Window.orderBy("min_level", "team_group", "level")).alias("next_min_level"),
        F.round(F.col("min_level") - F.avg("min_level").over(Window.partitionBy("max_level")), 2).alias("min_level_vs_max_level_avg"),

    .drop("overall_min_max_level")

result = (

    .pivot("team_group", ["group_b", "other", "group_a"])

        MIN(median_score) OVER w_grade_status_group AS grade_status_group_min_median_score,

)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at") < F.lit("2025-02-24 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("grade_status"))).alias("grade_status_len"),
        F.when(F.col("grade_status").isin("FAIL", "PASS"), "group_a").when(F.col("grade_status") == "INCOMPLETE", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("grade_status_group"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    filtered_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status_len") < 12)
    .groupBy("grade_status_group")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("score"), 2).alias("stddev_score"),
        F.round(F.sum("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("grade_status_len"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("score_to_grade_status_len_ratio"),
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("first_enrolled_at"),

    .drop("overall_avg_median_score")

w_grade_status_group = Window.partitionBy("grade_status_group")
ranked = (
    filtered
    .select(

        (F.col("distinct_student_ids") - F.lag("distinct_student_ids").over(Window.orderBy("stddev_score", "grade_status_group"))).alias("distinct_student_ids_change"),
        F.max("median_score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status_group")).alias("grade_status_group_max_median_score"),
        F.min("median_score").over(w_grade_status_group).alias("grade_status_group_min_median_score"),
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") - F.avg("n_rows").over(w_grade_status_group), 2).alias("n_rows_vs_grade_status_group_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy("distinct_student_ids")
    .pivot("grade_status_group", ["other", "group_a", "group_b"])

        MIN(max_policy_premium) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cobbler_span), status) AS start_date_month_status_min_max_policy_premium,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cobbler_span), status) AS rows_in_start_date_month_status
    FROM with_counts
),

    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(status, '#', CAST(cedar_orchard AS STRING)) AS status_ref,
        DATEDIFF(end_date, cobbler_span) AS days_start_date_to_end_date,

    rows_in_start_date_month_status,
    start_date_year,
    CASE WHEN premium_sum_4 >= 11300.0 THEN 'A' WHEN premium_sum_4 >= 6120.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS premium_sum_4_tier

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_canisters
    .filter((~F.col("status").isin("ACTIVE", "EXPIRED")) & (F.year(F.col("end_date")) == 2026))
    .select(
        "id",
        "cedar_orchard",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "cobbler_span",
        "end_date",
        "status",
    )
)

policy_stats = (
    df_canisters
    .groupBy("cedar_orchard")
    .agg(F.max("premium").alias("max_policy_premium"))
)

with_counts = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(policy_stats.alias("p"), F.col("p.cedar_orchard") == F.col("s.cedar_orchard"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "p.max_policy_premium")
)

with_windows = (
    with_counts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("cobbler_span"), "status").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("prev_premium"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("cobbler_span"), "status").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc_nulls_first())), 3).alias("end_date_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("premium").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("max_policy_premium").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("premium_sum_4"),
        F.round(F.col("max_policy_premium") / F.nullif(F.sum("max_policy_premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "cobbler_span"), "status")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("pacific_frescoe"),
        F.min("max_policy_premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "cobbler_span"), "status")).alias("start_date_month_status_min_max_policy_premium"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "cobbler_span"), "status")).alias("rows_in_start_date_month_status"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(F.col("status"), F.lit("#"), F.col("cedar_orchard").cast("string")).alias("status_ref"),
        F.datediff(F.col("end_date"), F.col("cobbler_span")).alias("days_start_date_to_end_date"),
        F.year(F.col("cobbler_span")).alias("start_date_year"),
    )
)

result = (
    tagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "cedar_orchard",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "status",
        "prev_premium",
        "end_date_cume_dist",
        "premium_sum_4",
        "pacific_frescoe",
        "rows_in_start_date_month_status",
        "start_date_year",
        F.when(F.col("premium_sum_4") >= 11300.0, "A").when(F.col("premium_sum_4") >= 6120.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("premium_sum_4_tier"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = df_stock_moves.filter((F.col("move_type") == "OUTBOUND") | (F.col("sku_id").isNotNull()))

combined_details = (
    cleaned.alias("s")
    .join(df_warehouses.alias("w"), F.col("w.id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_skus.alias("sk"), F.col("sk.id") == F.col("s.sku_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.warehouse_id",
        "s.sku_id",
        "s.qty",
        "s.moved_at",
        "s.operator",
        "s.unit_price",
        F.col("w.wh_code").alias("warehouse_wh_code"),
        F.col("sk.is_active").alias("sku_is_active"),
    )
)

w_sku_id = Window.partitionBy("sku_id")
sequenced = (
    combined_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_sku_id).alias("rows_in_sku_id"),
        F.first("unit_price", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_unit_price"),
        F.max("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("operator", "sku_is_active").orderBy("moved_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_qty_so_far"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty")).alias("qty_dense_rank"),
        (F.col("qty") - F.lag("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("operator", "sku_is_active").orderBy("moved_at", "id"))).alias("qty_change"),
        F.max("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_qty_so_far_2"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty", "id")).alias("qty_decile"),
        F.round(F.col("qty") / F.nullif(F.sum("qty").over(w_sku_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("qty_share_of_sku_id"),
        F.round(F.col("qty") - F.avg("qty").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id")), 2).alias("qty_vs_sku_id_avg"),
        F.max("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("unit_price_max_6_prior"),
        F.nth_value("unit_price", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_is_active").orderBy("qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_unit_price"),
        F.min("qty").over(w_sku_id).alias("sku_id_min_qty"),

    )
)

stats = (
    sequenced
    .groupBy("sku_id", "qty_decile", "warehouse_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.min("unit_price").alias("min_unit_price"),
        F.max("second_unit_price").alias("max_second_unit_price"),
        F.round(F.avg("max_qty_so_far"), 2).alias("avg_max_qty_so_far"),
        F.sum("running_qty").alias("total_running_qty"),
        F.round(F.stddev("running_qty"), 2).alias("stddev_running_qty"),
    )
)

w_n_rows_qty_decile = Window.partitionBy("n_rows", "qty_decile")
ranked = (
    stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("warehouse_id").over(w_n_rows_qty_decile)).alias("distinct_warehouse_id_in_n_rows_qty_decile"),
        F.min("qty_decile").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows", "qty_decile")).alias("n_rows_qty_decile_min_qty_decile"),
        F.last("stddev_running_qty").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows").orderBy("n_rows", "sku_id", "qty_decile", "warehouse_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_stddev_running_qty"),
        F.first("qty_decile").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows", "sku_id").orderBy(F.col("n_rows").desc(), "sku_id", "qty_decile", "warehouse_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_qty_decile"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "sku_id",
        "qty_decile",
        "warehouse_id",
        "n_rows",
        "max_second_unit_price",
        "avg_max_qty_so_far",
        "total_running_qty",
        "stddev_running_qty",
        "distinct_warehouse_id_in_n_rows_qty_decile",
        "last_stddev_running_qty",
        "first_qty_decile",
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") / F.nullif(F.col("first_qty_decile"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("n_rows_per_first_qty_decile"),
        F.when(F.col("qty_decile") >= 7, "HIGH").when(F.col("qty_decile") >= 4, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("qty_decile_tier"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("n_rows_per_first_qty_decile").asc_nulls_last())
)

session_summary AS (

        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,

        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

)

    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS attr_key, value
),
valid AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(status_code) AS status_code_whole,

    FROM exploded
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND attr_key IN ('trace', 'version')
),
flagged AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, attr_key) IS NULL
                 OR log_ts > LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, attr_key) + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM valid
),
sessions_app_logs AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        attr_key,
        status_code_whole,
        log_ts_hour,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

latest AS (

    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, level ORDER BY log_ts, id, attr_key) AS latest_rank

)

    COUNT(*) AS cnt,

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session

    FROM sessionized

),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows

    FROM session_summary
),
grouped AS (

        burst_id,
        DATE_FORMAT(session_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_start_ym,

        SUM(session_requester_id) AS total_session_requester_id,
        MIN(session_requester_id) AS min_session_requester_id,
        ROUND(AVG(session_start_quarter), 2) AS avg_session_start_quarter,
        ROUND(STDDEV(duration_min), 2) AS stddev_duration_min,
        ROUND(STDDEV(session_requester_id), 2) AS stddev_session_requester_id
    FROM tagged
    GROUP BY burst_id, DATE_FORMAT(session_start, 'yyyy-MM'), session_start_quarter
    HAVING SUM(event_count) > 2
)
SELECT

    n_priority_in_p4_p1,
    total_session_requester_id,

        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("channel")), 1, 3).alias("channel_prefix"),
    )
)

with_prev = base_tickets.withColumn("prev_closed_at", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_closed_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("closed_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_closed_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("priority").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(s.claimed_amount - g.max_claimed_amount, 2) AS claimed_amount_minus_max
    FROM with_stats s
    JOIN status_stats g ON g.status = s.status
    WHERE s.claimed_amount = g.max_claimed_amount
)
SELECT id, metric, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT id, approved_amount, max_claimed_amount
    FROM above_average

UNPIVOT (

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_claims
    .filter((F.col("adjuster_id").isNotNull()) | (F.col("policy_id") >= 20))
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "status",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("status")), " ", "_")).alias("status_slug"),
    )
)

claim_stats = (
    df_claims
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("claim_date").alias("first_claim_date"),
        F.count("*").alias("claim_count"),
        F.min("claimed_amount").alias("min_claim_claimed_amount"),
    )
)

with_stats = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(claim_stats.alias("c"), F.col("c.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "c.first_claim_date",
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.claim_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("claim_count"),
        "c.min_claim_claimed_amount",

status_stats = (

above_average = (

    .join(status_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.status") == F.col("s.status"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.claimed_amount") == F.col("g.max_claimed_amount"))
    .select(

result = (

        "sku_id",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
    )
)

)

stats = (

        "event_count",
    )
    .agg(

WITH fail_by_student AS (
    -- FAIL rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS fail_count, SUM(score) AS fail_total_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'FAIL'
    GROUP BY student_id
),
withdrawn_by_student AS (
    -- WITHDRAWN rows per student_id
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS withdrawn_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS withdrawn_avg_score
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'WITHDRAWN'
    GROUP BY student_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.student_id, b.student_id) AS student_id,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count,
    a.fail_total_score,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    b.withdrawn_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.fail_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM fail_by_student a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_by_student b
  ON a.student_id = b.student_id
ORDER BY student_id
```

fail_by_student = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL")
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("fail_count"),
        F.sum("score").alias("fail_total_score"),
    )
)

withdrawn_by_student = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "WITHDRAWN")
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("score"), 2).alias("withdrawn_avg_score"),
    )
)

result = (
    fail_by_student.alias("a")
    .join(withdrawn_by_student.alias("b"), F.col("a.student_id") == F.col("b.student_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.student_id"), F.col("b.student_id")).alias("student_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.fail_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("fail_count"),
        F.col("a.fail_total_score"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("withdrawn_count"),
        F.col("b.withdrawn_avg_score"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.fail_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.withdrawn_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("student_id")

    )
)

w_all_by_voltage_minus_kwh = Window.orderBy(F.col("voltage_minus_kwh").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
windowed = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")), 2).alias("site_id_avg_voltage"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")).alias("rows_in_site_id"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage_minus_kwh").desc())).alias("voltage_minus_kwh_rank"),

        F.min("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id")).alias("site_id_min_voltage"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_all_by_voltage_minus_kwh).alias("voltage_minus_kwh_dense_rank"),
        F.last("voltage_minus_kwh", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_voltage_minus_kwh"),
        F.lead("voltage_minus_kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("voltage").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("next_voltage_minus_kwh"),

        F.lag("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_kwh"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("voltage").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("voltage_dense_rank"),

        F.lead("voltage_minus_kwh", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_voltage_minus_kwh"),

)

    )

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_concession_sales
    .filter((F.lower(F.col("vendor_label")).like("%ky%")) & (F.col("terminal_id").isNotNull()))
    .select(

        "terminal_id",
        "lane_type",
        "bag_state",
        "lane_throughput",
        "opened_on",
        "vendor_label",
    )
)

with_activity = (
    scoped
    .crossJoin(scoped.agg(F.avg("lane_throughput").alias("overall_avg_lane_throughput")))
    .filter(F.col("lane_throughput") > F.col("overall_avg_lane_throughput"))
    .drop("overall_avg_lane_throughput")
)

labeled = (
    with_activity
    .filter(F.col("bag_state").isNotNull())

        "lane_type",
        "lane_throughput",
        "opened_on",
        "vendor_label",

        F.date_format(F.col("opened_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("opened_on_label"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    labeled
    .groupBy("lane_type")
    .agg(

        "grade_level",
        "exam_day",
        "club_codes",
        F.date_format(F.col("exam_day"), "MMM yyyy").alias("exam_day_label"),
        F.date_format(F.col("exam_day"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("exam_day_label_2"),

        "received_on",
        "min_slot_minutes_so_far",
        "slot_minutes_seq",

cleaned AS (

        CASE WHEN venue_surface = 'turf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_turf

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

metrics = (
    df_dim_venues
    .select(
        "id",
        "venue_surface",
        "sprint_kmh",
        "flag_is_home",
        F.corr("sprint_kmh", "minutes_played").over(Window.partitionBy("venue_surface")).alias("corr_sprint_kmh_minutes_played"),
        F.avg("minutes_played").over(Window.partitionBy("venue_surface").orderBy(F.col("kickoff_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)).alias("minutes_played_avg_7d"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("venue_surface").orderBy(F.col("minutes_played_avg_7d").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "venue_surface")
)

filtered = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("venue_surface").isin(["turf", "grass", "hybrid"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("venue_surface").alias("clean_venue_surface"),
        F.when(F.col("venue_surface").isin(["grass", "turf"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("venue_surface_group"),
    )
)

cleaned = (

        "*",
        F.lower("venue_surface").alias("venue_surface_lower"),
        F.when(F.col("venue_surface") == "turf", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_turf"),
    )
)

result = (

    .groupBy(
        "venue_surface",
        F.when(F.col("is_turf") >= 71, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("is_turf_tier"),

    .agg(
        F.sum("is_turf").alias("total_is_turf"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_turf", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_turf_quartiles"),
        F.count_if(F.col("venue_surface") == "hybrid").alias("hybrid_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_turf", 0.9).alias("is_turf_p90"),
    )
    .orderBy("is_turf_tier")
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_3d"),
    )
)

w_sku_id_by_moved_at = Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy("moved_at", "id")
w_prior_rows_3d_moved_at_month = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_3d", F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at")).orderBy(F.col("prior_unit_price_3d").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
windowed = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "moved_at",
        "prior_rows_3d",
        "prior_unit_price_3d",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_prior_rows_3d).alias("rows_in_prior_rows_3d"),
        F.lag("prior_rows_3d").over(w_sku_id_by_moved_at).alias("prev_prior_rows_3d"),
        F.min("prior_unit_price_3d").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_3d")).alias("prior_rows_3d_min_prior_unit_price_3d"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("moved_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("moved_at").over(w_prior_rows_3d_moved_at_month))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_moved_at"),
    )
)

w_all_by_prev_prior_rows_3d = Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_prior_rows_3d").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
windowed_2 = (

    .select(

        "prev_prior_rows_3d",
        F.round(F.avg("prev_prior_rows_3d").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("rows_in_prior_rows_3d").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("prev_prior_rows_3d_avg_3_prior"),
        (F.col("prior_rows_3d") - F.lag("prior_rows_3d").over(w_all_by_prev_prior_rows_3d)).alias("prior_rows_3d_change"),
        F.max("rows_in_prior_rows_3d").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_prior_rows_3d").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("rows_in_prior_rows_3d_max_4"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "rows_in_prior_rows_3d",
        "prev_prior_rows_3d",
        "prev_prior_rows_3d_avg_3_prior",
        "prior_rows_3d_change",
        "rows_in_prior_rows_3d_max_4",
        F.coalesce(F.col("prev_prior_rows_3d"), F.lit(0)).alias("prev_prior_rows_3d_filled"),

session_summary AS (

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

PIVOT (

            SELECT c.hire_date, c.level
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        level,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS budget_share,
        LAST_VALUE(budget) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_budget,
        LAG(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY budget, id) AS prev_budget
    FROM latest_match
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.level,
        s.budget_share,
        x.hire_date
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
totals AS (

        CASE WHEN budget_share >= 0.75 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS budget_share_tier,

        COUNT_IF(level = 'L3') AS l3_events,
        COUNT_IF(level = 'L4') AS l4_events,
        AVG(budget_share) AS avg_budget_share,
        ROUND(SUM(budget_share) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'L1' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS budget_share_per_l1
    FROM with_latest
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_share >= 0.75 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END

    l3_events,

        ROUND(AVG(tick_volume_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id, MONTH(bid_at) ORDER BY tick_volume DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS tick_volume_bucket_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(tick_volume - AVG(tick_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id, commodity), 2) AS tick_volume_vs_trading_post_id_commodity_avg,
        LAST_VALUE(tick_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id ORDER BY bid_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_tick_volume,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY commodity, MONTH(bid_at)) AS rows_in_commodity_bid_at_month,
        LEAD(tick_volume) OVER w_commodity_trading_post_id_by AS next_tick_volume,
        LEAD(bid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id ORDER BY bid_at DESC, id) AS next_bid_at,
        ROUND(lot_grade_number / NULLIF(SUM(lot_grade_number) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id, commodity), 0), 4) AS lot_grade_number_share_of_trading_post_id_commod,
        NTH_VALUE(tick_volume, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY commodity, trading_post_id ORDER BY lot_grade_number DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_tick_volume,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_grade_number, trading_post_id ORDER BY tick_volume DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count,
        NTH_VALUE(bid_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY trading_post_id ORDER BY tick_volume_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_bid_at,
        MIN(lot_grade_number) OVER w_trading_post_id_commodity AS trading_post_id_commodity_min_lot_grade_number,

        ROUND(AVG(tick_volume_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY commodity, MONTH(bid_at)), 2) AS commodity_bid_at_month_avg_tick_volume_bucket
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_bid_at_to_date_trading_post AS (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(bid_at), trading_post_id ORDER BY bid_at), w_commodity_trading_post_id_by AS (PARTITION BY commodity, trading_post_id ORDER BY lot_grade_number DESC, id), w_trading_post_id_commodity AS (PARTITION BY trading_post_id, commodity)

    COALESCE(a.claimed_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.delayed_count, 0) AS net_count

        F.last("monthly_fee_rounded", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("last_known_monthly_fee_rounded"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("end_date") >= F.lit("2023-10-27").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff("end_date", "start_date") / 7).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date"),
        (F.col("monthly_fee") / F.nullif("start_date_month_avg_2_prior", F.lit(0))).alias("monthly_fee_per_start_date_month_avg_2_prior"),

    df_meter_readings

        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
    )
)

w_all_by_read_at = Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")
w_read_at_month_site_id = Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")
metrics = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("read_at_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(w_all_by_read_at))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_read_at_month_site_id).alias("rows_in_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("voltage_avg_7"),
        F.min("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")).alias("read_at_month_site_id_min_quality_len"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("voltage_avg_3"),
        F.lag("quality_len", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("prev2_quality_len"),
        F.first("read_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_read_at"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") / F.nullif(F.sum("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("quality_len_share_of_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")).alias("read_at_tercile"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.last("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_kwh"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("quality").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id"))).alias("distinct_quality_in_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage")), 3).alias("voltage_cume_dist"),
    )
)

w_prev2_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("prev2_quality_len")
sequenced = (

        "*",
        F.sum("voltage_avg_3").over(Window.partitionBy("prev2_quality_len")).alias("prev2_quality_len_sum_voltage_avg_3"),
        F.max("minutes_since_prev_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("voltage_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_minutes_since_prev_read_at_so_far"),
        F.sum("minutes_since_prev_read_at").over(w_prev2_quality_len).alias("prev2_quality_len_sum_minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
    )
)

totals = (

    .groupBy("prev2_quality_len")

    df_azure_engines
    .select(

        "round_ended_ts",

    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_round_ended_ts", F.lag("round_ended_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("game_mode").orderBy("round_ended_ts", "id")))

    with_prev

)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("game_mode").orderBy("round_ended_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (

    .groupBy("game_mode", "burst_id")

        F.size(F.collect_set("game_mode").over(w_n_events)).alias("distinct_game_mode_in_n_events"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_policies
    .filter(F.col("end_date").between(F.lit("2025-10-12").cast("date"), F.lit("2026-11-25").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
    )
)

with_parent = (
    prepared_policys.alias("s")
    .join(df_policyholders.alias("p"), (F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.holder_id")) & (F.col("p.holder_name").isNotNull()), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.region") == "West")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.holder_id",
        "s.product",
        "s.premium",
        "s.end_date",
        "s.status",
        F.col("p.segment").alias("holder_segment"),
        F.col("p.joined_on").alias("holder_joined_on"),
        F.col("p.region").alias("holder_region"),
    )
)

w_holder_id_holder_segment = Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "holder_segment")
w_status = Window.partitionBy("status")
metrics = (
    with_parent
    .select(
        "id",
        "premium",
        "holder_joined_on",
        "holder_region",
        F.sum("premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "holder_id").orderBy("holder_joined_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_premium"),
        F.sum("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "holder_segment")).alias("holder_id_holder_segment_sum_premium"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_holder_id_holder_segment).alias("rows_in_holder_id_holder_segment"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "holder_segment")), 2).alias("holder_id_holder_segment_avg_premium"),
        F.lead("holder_joined_on").over(Window.orderBy("end_date", "id")).alias("next_holder_joined_on"),
        F.datediff(F.col("holder_joined_on"), F.lag("holder_joined_on").over(Window.partitionBy("product", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_joined_on", "id"))).alias("days_since_prev_holder_joined_on"),
        F.first("holder_joined_on").over(Window.partitionBy("product", "holder_id").orderBy("holder_joined_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_holder_joined_on"),
        F.first("premium", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product").orderBy(F.col("holder_joined_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_premium"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium").over(w_status), 2).alias("status_avg_premium"),
        F.round(F.col("premium") - F.avg("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id", "holder_segment")), 2).alias("premium_vs_holder_id_holder_segment_avg"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("end_date_quartile"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("rows_in_status"),
    )
)

derived = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last_day(F.col("first_holder_joined_on")).alias("first_holder_joined_on_month_end"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("holder_region")), 1, 2).alias("holder_region_prefix"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("first_holder_joined_on")).alias("days_since_first_holder_joined_on"),

)

w_all_by_holder_joined_on = Window.orderBy("holder_joined_on", "id")
with_trends = (

        "premium",
        "rows_in_holder_id_holder_segment",
        "next_holder_joined_on",
        "days_since_prev_holder_joined_on",
        "first_known_premium",
        "status_avg_premium",
        "premium_vs_holder_id_holder_segment_avg",
        "end_date_quartile",
        "rows_in_status",
        "first_holder_joined_on_month_end",
        F.lead("next_holder_joined_on", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("holder_region").orderBy("days_since_prev_holder_joined_on", "id")).alias("next3_next_holder_joined_on"),
        F.lag("rows_in_status").over(w_all_by_holder_joined_on).alias("prev_rows_in_status"),
        F.datediff(F.col("holder_joined_on"), F.lag("holder_joined_on").over(w_all_by_holder_joined_on)).alias("days_since_prev_holder_joined_on_2"),
        F.sum("end_date_quartile").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_region")).alias("holder_region_sum_end_date_quartile"),

        F.sum("status_avg_premium").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_region")).alias("holder_region_sum_status_avg_premium"),
        F.round(F.col("premium") / F.nullif(F.sum("premium").over(Window.partitionBy("holder_region")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("premium_share_of_holder_region"),
    )
)

stats = (
    with_trends
    .groupBy(
        F.date_format("first_holder_joined_on_month_end", "yyyy-MM").alias("first_holder_joined_on_month_end_ym"),
        "end_date_quartile",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.max("premium_share_of_holder_region").alias("max_premium_share_of_holder_region"),
        F.round(F.avg("status_avg_premium"), 2).alias("avg_status_avg_premium"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .filter(F.col("avg_status_avg_premium") >= 1640.0)
    .select(
        "first_holder_joined_on_month_end_ym",
        "end_date_quartile",
        "row_count",
        "avg_status_avg_premium",
    )
)

    FROM combined_details_site

enriched_site AS (

        s.id,

        s.quality_ref_ref,

)

tagged = (
    combined_details_site

    .select(

outliers = (

        gpa_adj,
        ROUND(AVG(garrison_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cobalt_furnace), is_international ORDER BY garrison_amt ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS days_since_enrolled_on_avg_4,
        NTH_VALUE(garrison_amt, 2) OVER (ORDER BY gpa_adj ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_days_since_enrolled_on
    FROM valid_students
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per cohort
    SELECT
        id,
        student_name,
        cohort,
        cobalt_furnace,
        is_international,
        garrison_amt,
        gpa_adj,
        days_since_enrolled_on_avg_4,
        second_days_since_enrolled_on
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort ORDER BY cobalt_furnace DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)

SELECT
    id,
    student_name,
    cohort,
    cobalt_furnace,
    garrison_amt,
    gpa_adj,
    days_since_enrolled_on_avg_4,
    second_days_since_enrolled_on,
